sentences.zh: 孫奇逢耿介黃宗羲弟宗炎宗會子百家王夫之兄介之李顒李因篤李柏王心敬沈國模史孝咸韓當邵曾可曾可孫廷採王朝式謝文洊甘京黃熙曾曰都危龍光湯其仁宋之盛鄧元昌高愈顧培彭定求湯之錡施璜張夏吳曰慎陸世儀陳瑚盛敬江士韶張履祥錢寅何汝霖凌克貞屠安世鄭宏祝洤沈昀姚宏任葉敦艮劉汋應撝謙朱鶴齡陳啟源范鎬鼎党成李生光白奐彩党湛王化泰孫景烈胡承諾曹本榮張貞生劉原淥姜國霖劉以貴韓夢周梁鴻翥法坤宏閻循觀任瑗顏元王源程廷祚惲鶴生李塨刁包王餘佑李來章冉覲祖竇克勤李光坡從子鍾倫莊亨陽官獻瑤王懋竑朱澤澐喬僅李夢箕子圖南張鵬翼童能靈胡方馮成修勞潼勞史桑調元汪鑒顧棟高陳祖范吳鼎梁錫璵孟超然汪紱余元遴姚學塽潘諮唐鑑吳嘉賓劉傳瑩劉熙載朱次琦成孺邵懿辰高均儒伊樂堯

translations.literal: This chapter treats Sun Qifeng, with Geng Jie; Huang Zongxi, with his brothers Zongyan and Zonghui and his son Baijia; Wang Fuzhi, with his elder brother Jiezhi; Li Yong, with Li Yindu, Li Bai, and Wang Xinjing; Shen Guomo, with Shi Xiaoxian, Han Dang, Shao Zengke, another Zengke, Sun Tingcai, and Wang Chaoshi; Xie Wenjian, with Gan Jing, Huang Xi, Zeng Yuedou, Wei Longguang, Tang Qiren, Song Zhisheng, and Deng Yuanchang; Gao Yu, with Gu Pei and Peng Dingqiu; Tang Zhiqi, with Shi Huang, Zhang Xia, and Wu Yueshen; Lu Shiyi, with Chen Hu, Sheng Jing, Jiang Shishao, Zhang Luxiang, Qian Yin, He Rulin, Ling Kezhen, Tu Anshi, Zheng Hong, and Zhu Quan; Shen Yun, with Yao Hongren, Ye Dungen, and Liu Zhuo; Ying Huiqian; Zhu Heling, with Chen Qiyuan; Fan Gaoding, with Dang Cheng and Li Shengguang; Bai Huancai, with Dang Zhan, Wang Huatai, and Sun Jinglie; Hu Chengnuo; Cao Benrong, with Zhang Zhensheng; Liu Yuanlu, with Jiang Guolin, Liu Yigui, Han Mengzhou, Liang Hongzhu, Fa Kunhong, Yan Xunguan, and Ren Yuan; Yan Yuan, with Wang Yuan, Cheng Tingzuo, and Yun Hesheng; Li Gong; Diao Bao, with Wang Yuyou; Li Laizhang, with Ran Jinzu and Dou Keqin; Li Guangpo, with his nephew Zhonglun; Zhuang Hengyang, with Guan Xianyao; Wang Maohong, with Zhu Zeyun and Qiao Jin; Li Mengji, with his son Tunan, Zhang Pengyi, and Tong Nengling; Hu Fang, with Feng Chengxiu and Lao Tong; Lao Shi, with Sang Diaoyuan and Wang Jian; Gu Donggao, with Chen Zufan, Wu Ding, and Liang Xiyu; Meng Chaoran; Wang Fu, with Yu Yuanlin; Yao Xueshuang, with Pan Zi; Tang Jian; Wu Jiabin, with Liu Chuanying; Liu Xizai; Zhu Ciqi; Cheng Ru; and Shao Yichen, with Gao Junru and Yi Lerao.
translations.idiomatic: This chapter treats Sun Qifeng, with Geng Jie; Huang Zongxi, with his brothers Zongyan and Zonghui and his son Baijia; Wang Fuzhi, with his elder brother Jiezhi; Li Yong, with Li Yindu, Li Bai, and Wang Xinjing; Shen Guomo, with Shi Xiaoxian, Han Dang, Shao Zengke, another Zengke, Sun Tingcai, and Wang Chaoshi; Xie Wenjian, with Gan Jing, Huang Xi, Zeng Yuedou, Wei Longguang, Tang Qiren, Song Zhisheng, and Deng Yuanchang; Gao Yu, with Gu Pei and Peng Dingqiu; Tang Zhiqi, with Shi Huang, Zhang Xia, and Wu Yueshen; Lu Shiyi, with Chen Hu, Sheng Jing, Jiang Shishao, Zhang Luxiang, Qian Yin, He Rulin, Ling Kezhen, Tu Anshi, Zheng Hong, and Zhu Quan; Shen Yun, with Yao Hongren, Ye Dungen, and Liu Zhuo; Ying Huiqian; Zhu Heling, with Chen Qiyuan; Fan Gaoding, with Dang Cheng and Li Shengguang; Bai Huancai, with Dang Zhan, Wang Huatai, and Sun Jinglie; Hu Chengnuo; Cao Benrong, with Zhang Zhensheng; Liu Yuanlu, with Jiang Guolin, Liu Yigui, Han Mengzhou, Liang Hongzhu, Fa Kunhong, Yan Xunguan, and Ren Yuan; Yan Yuan, with Wang Yuan, Cheng Tingzuo, and Yun Hesheng; Li Gong; Diao Bao, with Wang Yuyou; Li Laizhang, with Ran Jinzu and Dou Keqin; Li Guangpo, with his nephew Zhonglun; Zhuang Hengyang, with Guan Xianyao; Wang Maohong, with Zhu Zeyun and Qiao Jin; Li Mengji, with his son Tunan, Zhang Pengyi, and Tong Nengling; Hu Fang, with Feng Chengxiu and Lao Tong; Lao Shi, with Sang Diaoyuan and Wang Jian; Gu Donggao, with Chen Zufan, Wu Ding, and Liang Xiyu; Meng Chaoran; Wang Fu, with Yu Yuanlin; Yao Xueshuang, with Pan Zi; Tang Jian; Wu Jiabin, with Liu Chuanying; Liu Xizai; Zhu Ciqi; Cheng Ru; and Shao Yichen, with Gao Junru and Yi Lerao.

sentences.zh: 昔周公制禮，太宰九兩繫邦國，三曰師，四曰儒；

translations.literal: In antiquity the Duke of Zhou established rites; the Grand Minister bound the states with nine categories—the third was teachers, the fourth was scholars;
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, when the Duke of Zhou established the rites, the Grand Minister used nine categories to bind the states: the third was teachers, the fourth was scholars;

sentences.zh: 復於司徒本俗聯以師儒。

translations.literal: Again under the Minister of Education, local customs were linked through teachers and scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Minister of Education, local customs were linked through teachers and scholars.

sentences.zh: 師以德行教民，儒以六藝教民。

translations.literal: Teachers instruct the people through virtue and conduct; scholars instruct the people through the Six Arts.
translations.idiomatic: Teachers instruct the people through virtue and conduct; scholars instruct the people through the Six Arts.

sentences.zh: 分合同異，周初已然矣。

translations.literal: Division and union, sameness and difference—this was already so in early Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Their division and union, sameness and difference, were already established in early Zhou.

sentences.zh: 數百年後，周禮在魯，儒術為盛。

translations.literal: Several hundred years later, the Rites of Zhou were in Lu, and Confucian learning flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Several centuries later, the Rites of Zhou were preserved in Lu, and Confucian learning flourished.

sentences.zh: 孔子以王法作述，道與藝合，兼備師儒。

translations.literal: Confucius composed and expounded according to royal law; the Way and the arts were united, combining teacher and scholar.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius expounded and composed according to royal principles, uniting the Way and the arts and combining the roles of teacher and scholar.

sentences.zh: 顏、曾所傳，以道兼藝；

translations.literal: What Yan and Zeng transmitted combined the Way with the arts;
translations.idiomatic: What Yan Hui and Zeng Shen transmitted combined the Way with the arts;

sentences.zh: 遊、夏之徒，以藝兼道。

translations.literal: The followers of You and Xia combined the arts with the Way.
translations.idiomatic: The disciples You and Xia combined the arts with the Way.

sentences.zh: 定、哀之間，儒術極醇，無少差繆者此也。

translations.literal: Between Ding and Ai, Confucian learning was at its purest, with scarcely any deviation—this was why.
translations.idiomatic: Between the reigns of Duke Ding and Duke Ai, Confucian learning reached its purest form, with scarcely any deviation—and this was why.

sentences.zh: 荀卿著論，儒術已乖。

translations.literal: When Xun Qing wrote his treatises, Confucian learning had already diverged.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun Qing wrote his treatises, Confucian learning had already gone astray.

sentences.zh: 然六經傳說，各有師授。

translations.literal: Yet the exegesis of the Six Classics, each with its own line of masters.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the exegesis of the Six Classics still had its own line of transmission for each.

sentences.zh: 秦棄儒籍，入漢復興。

translations.literal: Qin discarded Confucian texts; upon entering Han they were revived.
translations.idiomatic: Qin discarded the Confucian classics; when Han rose, they were revived.

sentences.zh: 雖黃老、刑名猶复淆雜，迨孝武盡黜百家，公、卿、大夫、士、吏，彬彬多文學矣。

translations.literal: Although Huang-Lao and Legalist teachings were still mixed in, by the time Emperor Xiaowu rejected all other schools, among dukes, ministers, grandees, gentlemen, and officials, many were steeped in literary learning.
translations.idiomatic: Although Huang-Lao and Legalist teachings were still intermixed, by the time Emperor Wu of Han rejected all other schools, dukes, ministers, grandees, gentlemen, and officials alike were widely steeped in literary learning.

sentences.zh: 東漢以後，學徒數万，章句漸疏。

translations.literal: After the Eastern Han, disciples numbered in the tens of thousands, and commentarial line-by-line study grew increasingly lax.
translations.idiomatic: After the Eastern Han, disciples numbered in the tens of thousands, and line-by-line commentarial study grew increasingly lax.

sentences.zh: 高名善士，半入黨流。

translations.literal: Men of high repute and virtue largely entered factional currents.
translations.idiomatic: Men of high repute and virtue largely joined factional currents.

sentences.zh: 迄乎魏、晉，儒風蓋已衰矣。

translations.literal: By the Wei and Jin periods, the Confucian tradition had largely declined.
translations.idiomatic: By the Wei and Jin periods, the Confucian tradition had largely waned.

sentences.zh: 司馬、班、範，皆以儒林立傳，敘述經師家法，授受秩然。

translations.literal: Sima, Ban, and Fan each devoted separate biographies to the Confucian forest, recounting the family methods of classicists and their orderly transmission from master to pupil.
translations.idiomatic: Sima, Ban, and Fan each devoted separate biographies to the Confucian forest, recounting the family methods of classicists and the orderly succession of master to pupil.

sentences.zh: 雖於周禮師教未盡克兼，然名儒大臣，匡時植教，祖述經說，文飾章疏，皆與儒林傳相出入。

translations.literal: Although in the Rites of Zhou the teacher's teaching was not entirely combined, eminent Confucians and high ministers who corrected the age and planted instruction, who traced and followed the classics and adorned commentaries and subcommentaries, all corresponded in large part with what appears in the Biographies of the Confucian Forest.
translations.idiomatic: Although in the Rites of Zhou the teacher's teaching was not entirely combined with that of the scholar, eminent Confucians and high ministers who corrected the age and planted instruction—who traced the classics and adorned commentaries and subcommentaries—all corresponded in large part with what appears in the Biographies of the Confucian Forest.

sentences.zh: 是以朝秉綱常，士敦名節，拯衰銷逆，多歷年所，則周、魯儒學之效也。

translations.literal: Thus the court upheld the moral order, gentlemen prized integrity, and the correction of decline and reversal of disorder lasted for many years—these were the effects of Zhou and Lu Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the court upheld the moral order, gentlemen prized integrity, and the correction of decline and reversal of disorder lasted for many years—these were the effects of Zhou and Lu Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 兩晉玄學盛興，儒道衰弱，南北割據，傳授漸殊。

translations.literal: In the two Jin dynasties arcane learning flourished, the Confucian Way weakened, north and south were divided, and transmission gradually differed.
translations.idiomatic: In the two Jin dynasties, arcane learning flourished while the Confucian Way weakened; north and south were divided, and transmission gradually diverged.

sentences.zh: 北魏、蕭梁，義疏甚密。

translations.literal: Under Northern Wei and Liang of Xiao, exegetical subcommentaries were very dense.
translations.idiomatic: Under Northern Wei and Liang of Xiao, exegetical subcommentaries were very dense.

sentences.zh: 北學守舊而疑新，南學喜新而得偽。

translations.literal: Northern learning clung to the old and doubted the new; southern learning favored the new and accepted forgeries.
translations.idiomatic: Northern learning clung to the old and doubted the new; southern learning favored the new and accepted forgeries.

sentences.zh: 至隋、唐五經正義成，而儒者鮮以專家古學相授受焉。

translations.literal: By the time the Correct Meaning of the Five Classics was completed in Sui and Tang, Confucians rarely transmitted specialized ancient learning from master to pupil.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the Correct Meaning of the Five Classics was completed in Sui and Tang, Confucians rarely transmitted specialized ancient learning from master to pupil.

sentences.zh: 宋初名臣，皆敦道誼。

translations.literal: In early Song, famous ministers all honored moral friendship.
translations.idiomatic: In early Song, famous ministers all honored moral friendship.

sentences.zh: 濂、洛以後，遂啟紫陽。

translations.literal: After Lian and Luo, Ziyang was opened.
translations.idiomatic: After the Lian and Luo schools, the Ziyang tradition was opened.

sentences.zh: 闡發心性，分析道理，孔、孟學行不明著於天下哉！

translations.literal: Elucidating human nature and analyzing principle—were not the learning and conduct of Confucius and Mencius made brilliantly clear throughout the world!
translations.idiomatic: Elucidating human nature and analyzing principle—were not the learning and conduct of Confucius and Mencius made brilliantly clear throughout the world!

sentences.zh: 宋史以道學、儒林分為二傳，不知此即周禮師、儒之異，後人創分，而闇合周道也。

translations.literal: The Song History divides them into separate biographies for the Learning of the Way and the Confucian Forest, not recognizing that this is the distinction between teachers and scholars in the Rites of Zhou; later men created the division, yet unknowingly accorded with Zhou practice.
translations.idiomatic: The Song History divides them into separate biographies for the Learning of the Way and the Confucian Forest, not recognizing that this is the distinction between teachers and scholars in the Rites of Zhou; later men created the division, yet unknowingly accorded with Zhou practice.

sentences.zh: 元、明之間，守先啟後，在於金華。

translations.literal: Between Yuan and Ming, preserving the earlier and opening the later lay with Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: Between Yuan and Ming, the work of preserving the earlier and opening the later lay with Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 洎乎河東、姚江，門戶分歧，遞興遞滅，然終不出朱、陸而已。

translations.literal: By the time of Hedong and Yaojiang, schools split into factions, rising and falling in turn, yet in the end none went beyond Zhu and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of Hedong and Yaojiang, schools split into factions, rising and falling in turn, yet in the end none went beyond Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan.

sentences.zh: 終明之世，學案百出，而經訓家法，寂然無聞。

translations.literal: Through the entire Ming dynasty, scholarly cases proliferated, while classical exegesis and family methods were heard no more.
translations.idiomatic: Through the entire Ming dynasty, scholarly cases proliferated, while classical exegesis and family methods fell silent.

sentences.zh: 揆之周禮，有師無儒，空疏甚矣。

translations.literal: Measured against the Rites of Zhou, there were teachers but no scholars—how hollow it had become!
translations.idiomatic: Measured against the Rites of Zhou, there were teachers but no scholars—how hollow it had become!

sentences.zh: 然其間臺閣風厲，持正扶危，學士名流，知能激發。

translations.literal: Yet in that interval, censorial and ministerial circles maintained stern standards and upheld the upright in peril; renowned scholars of the academies knew how to rouse themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in that interval, censorial and ministerial circles maintained stern standards and upheld the upright in peril; renowned scholars of the academies knew how to rouse themselves.

sentences.zh: 雖多私議，或傷國體，然其正道，實拯世心。

translations.literal: Although there was much partisan dispute and at times injury to the body politic, their right path truly rescued the hearts of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Although there was much partisan dispute and at times injury to the body politic, their right path truly rescued the hearts of the age.

sentences.zh: 是故兩漢名教，得儒經之功；

translations.literal: Therefore the famous teaching of the two Han dynasties owed its strength to the Confucian classics;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the famous teaching of the two Han dynasties owed its strength to the Confucian classics;

sentences.zh: 宋、明講學，得師道之益：皆於周、孔之道，得其分合，未可偏譏而互誚也。

translations.literal: The lecture-learning of Song and Ming gained from the teacher's Way: both obtained the division and union of the Zhou and Confucian Way and cannot be one-sidedly mocked or mutually ridiculed.
translations.idiomatic: The lecture-learning of Song and Ming gained from the teacher's Way: both obtained the division and union of the Zhou and Confucian Way and cannot be one-sidedly mocked or mutually ridiculed.

sentences.zh: 清興，崇宋學之性道，而以漢儒經義實之。

translations.literal: When the Qing rose, it honored the Song learning of human nature and the Way, substantiating it with Han Confucian classical meaning.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qing rose, it honored the Song learning of human nature and the Way, substantiating it with Han Confucian classical meaning.

sentences.zh: 御纂諸經，兼收歷代之說；

translations.literal: The imperially compiled classics gathered commentaries from every dynasty;
translations.idiomatic: The imperially compiled classics gathered commentaries from every dynasty;

sentences.zh: 四庫館開，風氣益精博矣。

translations.literal: When the Siku Pavilion opened, scholarly spirit grew ever more refined and broad.
translations.idiomatic: When the Siku Pavilion opened, scholarly spirit grew ever more refined and broad.

sentences.zh: 國初講學，如孫奇逢、李顒等，沿前明王、薛之派，陸隴其、王懋竑等，始專守朱子，辨偽得真。

translations.literal: Early in the dynasty, those who lectured and learned, such as Sun Qifeng and Li Yong, followed the Wang and Xue school of the former Ming; Lu Longqi, Wang Maohong, and others began exclusively to uphold Zhu Xi and distinguish the false from the true.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty, those who lectured and learned, such as Sun Qifeng and Li Yong, followed the Wang and Xue school of the former Ming; Lu Longqi, Wang Maohong, and others began exclusively to uphold Zhu Xi and distinguish the false from the true.

sentences.zh: 高愈、應撝謙等，堅苦自持，不愧實踐。

translations.literal: Gao Yu, Ying Huiqian, and others, stern and hard in self-discipline, were worthy of genuine practice.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yu, Ying Huiqian, and others, stern and hard in self-discipline, were worthy of genuine practice.

sentences.zh: 閻若璩、胡渭等，卓然不惑，求是辨誣。

translations.literal: Yan Ruoju, Hu Wei, and others stood firm and unconfused, seeking truth and refuting error.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Ruoju, Hu Wei, and others stood firm and unconfused, seeking truth and refuting error.

sentences.zh: 惠棟、戴震等，精發古義，詁釋聖言。

translations.literal: Hui Dong, Dai Zhen, and others finely elucidated ancient meaning and glossed the words of the sages.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Dong, Dai Zhen, and others finely elucidated ancient meaning and glossed the words of the sages.

sentences.zh: 後如孔廣森之於公羊春秋，張惠言之於孟、虞易說，凌廷堪、胡培翬之於儀禮，孫詒讓之於周禮，陳奐之於毛詩，皆專家孤學也。

translations.literal: Later, such as Kong Guangsen on the Gongyang Spring and Autumn Annals, Zhang Huiyan on the Meng and Yu interpretations of the Changes, Ling Tingkan and Hu Peihui on the Ceremonies, Sun Yirang on the Rites of Zhou, and Chen Huan on the Mao Odes—all were specialists in solitary learning.
translations.idiomatic: Later, such as Kong Guangsen on the Gongyang Spring and Autumn Annals, Zhang Huiyan on the Meng and Yu interpretations of the Changes, Ling Tingkan and Hu Peihui on the Ceremonies, Sun Yirang on the Rites of Zhou, and Chen Huan on the Mao Odes—all were specialists in solitary learning.

sentences.zh: 且諸儒好古敏求，各造其域，不立門戶，不相黨伐，束身踐行，闇然自修。

translations.literal: Moreover, these Confucians loved antiquity and pursued inquiry keenly, each reaching his own domain; they did not establish schools, form factions, or attack one another; they restrained themselves and practiced, quietly cultivating themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, these Confucians loved antiquity and pursued inquiry keenly, each reaching his own domain; they did not establish schools, form factions, or attack one another; they restrained themselves and practiced, quietly cultivating themselves.

sentences.zh: 周、魯師儒之道，可謂兼古昔所不能兼者矣。

translations.literal: The teacher-scholar Way of Zhou and Lu may be said to have combined what even antiquity could not combine.
translations.idiomatic: The teacher-scholar Way of Zhou and Lu may be said to have combined what even antiquity could not combine.

sentences.zh: 綜而論之，聖人之道，譬若宮牆，文字訓詁，其門徑也。

translations.literal: Taken together, the Way of the sages is like a palace wall; philology and exegesis are its gate and path.
translations.idiomatic: Taken together, the Way of the sages is like a palace wall; philology and exegesis are its gate and path.

sentences.zh: 門徑苟誤，跬步皆歧，安能升堂入室？

translations.literal: If the gate and path are wrong, every step leads astray—how can one ascend to the hall and enter the inner chambers?
translations.idiomatic: If the gate and path are wrong, every step leads astray—how can one ascend to the hall and enter the inner chambers?

sentences.zh: 學人求道太高，卑視章句，譬猶天際之翔，出於豐屋之上，高則高矣，戶奧之間，未實窺也。

translations.literal: Scholars who seek the Way too loftily and look down on commentarial line-by-line study are like soaring in the sky above a grand house: high indeed, yet they have not truly peered into the inner rooms.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars who seek the Way too loftily and look down on line-by-line commentarial study are like soaring in the sky above a grand house: high indeed, yet they have not truly peered into the inner rooms.

sentences.zh: 或者但求名物，不論聖道，又若終年寢饋於門廡之間，無復知有堂室矣。

translations.literal: Or some seek only names and things and ignore the sage's Way, like sleeping and eating year-round in the vestibule without ever knowing there is a hall within.
translations.idiomatic: Or some seek only names and things and ignore the sage's Way, like sleeping and eating year-round in the vestibule without ever knowing there is a hall within.

sentences.zh: 是故但立宗旨，即居大名，此一蔽也。

translations.literal: Therefore merely to set up a doctrine is to occupy a great name—this is one partiality.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore merely to set up a doctrine is to occupy a great name—this is one partiality.

sentences.zh: 經義確然，雖不逾閒，德便出入，此又一蔽也。

translations.literal: When classical meaning is settled and fixed, even if one does not overstep bounds, virtue may come and go at will—this is another partiality.
translations.idiomatic: When classical meaning is settled and fixed, even if one does not overstep bounds, virtue may come and go at will—this is another partiality.

sentences.zh: 今為儒林傳，未敢區分門徑，惟期記述學行；

translations.literal: Now, in compiling the Biographies of the Confucian Forest, I dare not divide gate and path; I only aim to record learning and conduct;
translations.idiomatic: Now, in compiling the Biographies of the Confucian Forest, I dare not divide gate and path; I only aim to record learning and conduct;

sentences.zh: 若有事可見，已列於正傳者，茲不復載焉。

translations.literal: Where matters are already visible and have been entered in the main biographies, they are not repeated here.
translations.idiomatic: Where matters are already visible and have been entered in the main biographies, they are not repeated here.

sentences.zh: 孫奇逢，字啟泰，又字鍾元，容城人。

translations.literal: Sun Qifeng, courtesy name Qitai, also courtesy name Zhongyuan, was a native of Rongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Qifeng, courtesy name Qitai, also courtesy name Zhongyuan, was a native of Rongcheng.

sentences.zh: 少倜儻，好奇節，而內行篤修。

translations.literal: In youth he was unconventional, fond of striking integrity, yet inwardly his conduct was deeply cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was unconventional, fond of striking integrity, yet inwardly his conduct was deeply cultivated.

sentences.zh: 負經世之學，欲以功業自著。

translations.literal: Bearing learning for ordering the age, he wished to distinguish himself through achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing learning for ordering the age, he wished to distinguish himself through achievement.

sentences.zh: 年十七，舉明萬曆二十八年順天鄉試。

translations.literal: At seventeen he passed the Shuntian provincial examination in Ming Wanli year twenty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: At seventeen he passed the Shuntian provincial examination in Ming Wanli year twenty-eight.

sentences.zh: 連丁父母憂，廬墓六年，旌表孝行。

translations.literal: He successively mourned both parents, lived by their graves for six years, and was commended for filial conduct.
translations.idiomatic: He successively mourned both parents, lived by their graves for six years, and was commended for filial conduct.

sentences.zh: 與定興鹿善繼講學，一室默對，以聖賢相期。

translations.literal: With Lu Shanji of Dingxing he lectured and learned; sitting face to face in one room, they set their hearts on the sages.
translations.idiomatic: With Lu Shanji of Dingxing he lectured and learned; sitting face to face in one room, they set their hearts on the sages.

sentences.zh: 天啟時，逆閹魏忠賢竊朝柄，左光斗、魏大中、周順昌以黨禍被逮。

translations.literal: In the Tianqi reign, the treacherous eunuch Wei Zhongxian seized control of the court; Zuo Guangdou, Wei Dazhong, and Zhou Shunchang were arrested in the factional purge.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianqi reign, the treacherous eunuch Wei Zhongxian seized control of the court; Zuo Guangdou, Wei Dazhong, and Zhou Shunchang were arrested in the factional purge.

sentences.zh: 奇逢、善繼故與三人友善。

translations.literal: Qifeng and Shanji had long been friendly with the three men.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng and Shanji had long been friendly with the three men.

sentences.zh: 是時善繼以主事贊大學士孫承宗軍事。

translations.literal: At this time Shanji, as a director, assisted the grand secretary Sun Chengzong in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Shanji, as a director, assisted the grand secretary Sun Chengzong in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 奇逢上書承宗，責以大義，請急疏救。

translations.literal: Qifeng wrote to Chengzong, rebuking him with the greater moral principle and asking him urgently to memorialize for their rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng wrote to Chengzong, rebuking him with the greater moral principle and asking him urgently to memorialize for their rescue.

sentences.zh: 承宗欲假入覲面陳，謀未就而光斗等已死廠獄。

translations.literal: Chengzong wished to borrow an audience on entering court to state the case personally; the plan had not been settled when Guangdou and the others had already died in the prison of the Eastern Depot.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong wished to borrow an audience on entering court to state the case personally; the plan had not been settled when Guangdou and the others had already died in the prison of the Eastern Depot.

sentences.zh: 逆閹誣坐光斗等贓鉅萬，嚴追家屬。

translations.literal: The treacherous eunuch framed Guangdou and the others on charges of enormous bribes, and rigorously pursued their families.
translations.idiomatic: The treacherous eunuch framed Guangdou and the others on charges of enormous bribes, and rigorously pursued their families.

sentences.zh: 奇逢與善繼之父鹿正、新城張果中集士民醵金代輸。

translations.literal: Qifeng, together with Shanji's father Lu Zheng and Zhang Guozhong of Xincheng, gathered gentlemen and commoners to contribute money on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng, together with Shanji's father Lu Zheng and Zhang Guozhong of Xincheng, gathered gentlemen and commoners to contribute money on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 光斗等卒賴以歸骨，世所傳范陽三烈士也。

translations.literal: Guangdou and the others at last were able to have their bones returned home—the famed Three Martyrs of Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdou and the others at last were able to have their bones returned home—the famed Three Martyrs of Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 台垣及巡撫交章論薦，不起。

translations.literal: Censorial officials and the provincial governor repeatedly memorialized recommending him, but he did not accept office.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials and the provincial governor repeatedly memorialized recommending him, but he did not accept office.

sentences.zh: 孫承宗欲疏請以職方起贊軍事，其後尚書范景文聘為贊畫，俱辭不就。

translations.literal: Sun Chengzong wished to memorialize requesting that he be raised from the Bureau of Appointments to assist in military affairs; afterward Minister Fan Jingwen invited him as strategic adviser—he declined both.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chengzong wished to memorialize requesting that he be raised from the Bureau of Appointments to assist in military affairs; afterward Minister Fan Jingwen invited him as strategic adviser—he declined both.

sentences.zh: 時畿內賊盜縱橫，奇逢攜家入易州五峰山，門生親故從而相保者數百家。

translations.literal: At the time bandits and robbers ran rampant within the capital region; Qifeng took his family into Wufeng Mountain in Yizhou, and several hundred households of disciples, kin, and friends followed him for mutual protection.
translations.idiomatic: At the time bandits and robbers ran rampant within the capital region; Qifeng took his family into Wufeng Mountain in Yizhou, and several hundred households of disciples, kin, and friends followed him for mutual protection.

sentences.zh: 奇逢為部署守禦，弦歌不輟，

translations.literal: Qifeng organized the defense arrangements; music and singing never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng organized the defense arrangements; music and singing never ceased.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，祭酒薛所蘊以奇逢學行可比元許衡、吳澄，薦長成均，奇逢以病辭。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, the libationer Xue Suoyun, judging Qifeng's learning and conduct comparable to the Yuan dynasty's Xu Heng and Wu Cheng, recommended him as head of the Directorate of Education; Qifeng declined on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi, the libationer Xue Suoyun, judging Qifeng's learning and conduct comparable to the Yuan dynasty's Xu Heng and Wu Cheng, recommended him as head of the Directorate of Education; Qifeng declined on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 七年，南徙輝縣之蘇門。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he moved south to Sumen in Huixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he moved south to Sumen in Huixian.

sentences.zh: 九年，工部郎馬光裕奉以夏峰田廬，遂率子弟躬耕，四方來學者亦授田使耕，所居成聚。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Bureau Director Ma Guangyu presented him with the fields and lodge at Xiafeng; he then led his sons and younger brothers in farming personally, and also granted fields to scholars who came from all directions to study, so that his residence became a community.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Bureau Director Ma Guangyu presented him with the fields and lodge at Xiafeng; he then led his sons and younger brothers in farming personally, and also granted fields to scholars who came from all directions to study, so that his residence became a community.

sentences.zh: 居夏峰二十有五年，屢徵不起。

translations.literal: He lived at Xiafeng for twenty-five years, repeatedly summoned but never accepting office.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at Xiafeng for twenty-five years, repeatedly summoned but never accepting office.

sentences.zh: 奇逢之學，原本像山、陽明，以慎獨為宗，以體認天理為要，以日用倫常為實際。

translations.literal: Qifeng's learning originated in Xiangshan and Yangming, took vigilant self-examination in solitude as its core, took recognizing the principle of Heaven as essential, and took daily human relations and constant norms as practical reality.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng's learning originated in Xiangshan and Yangming, took vigilant self-examination in solitude as its core, took recognizing the principle of Heaven as essential, and took daily human relations and constant norms as practical reality.

sentences.zh: 其治身務自刻厲。

translations.literal: In governing himself he was strict in self-discipline.
translations.idiomatic: In governing himself he was strict in self-discipline.

sentences.zh: 人無賢愚，苟問學，必開以性之所近，使自力於庸行。

translations.literal: Whether a person was worthy or foolish, if he asked about learning, Qifeng would always open him according to what was nearest in his nature, so that he might strive on his own in ordinary conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Whether a person was worthy or foolish, if he asked about learning, Qifeng would always open him according to what was nearest in his nature, so that he might strive on his own in ordinary conduct.

sentences.zh: 其與人無町畦，雖武夫捍卒、野夫牧豎，必以誠意接之。

translations.literal: In dealing with others he had no petty boundaries; even bold soldiers, guards, rustics, and shepherds—he always received them with sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: In dealing with others he had no petty boundaries; even bold soldiers, guards, rustics, and shepherds—he always received them with sincerity.

sentences.zh: 用此名在天下而人無忌嫉。

translations.literal: Because of this his reputation stood in the realm yet no one envied him.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this his reputation stood in the realm yet no one envied him.

sentences.zh: 著讀易大旨五卷。

translations.literal: He wrote Outline of Reading the Changes in five juan.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Outline of Reading the Changes in five juan.

sentences.zh: 奇逢學易於雄縣李崶，至年老，乃撮其體要以示門人。

translations.literal: Qifeng studied the Changes under Li Feng of Xiong County; only in old age did he extract its essentials to show his disciples.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng studied the Changes under Li Feng of Xiong County; only in old age did he extract its essentials to show his disciples.

sentences.zh: 發明義理，切近人事。

translations.literal: He elucidated principle and meaning close to human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He elucidated principle and meaning close to human affairs.

sentences.zh: 以像、傳通一卦之旨，由一卦通六十四卦之義。

translations.literal: Through the Images and Commentary he penetrated the purport of one hexagram, and through one hexagram the meaning of all sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Images and Commentary he penetrated the purport of one hexagram, and through one hexagram the meaning of all sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 其生平之學，主於實用，故所言皆關法戒。

translations.literal: His lifelong learning emphasized practical utility; therefore what he said always bore on laws and admonitions.
translations.idiomatic: His lifelong learning emphasized practical utility; therefore what he said always bore on laws and admonitions.

sentences.zh: 又著理學傳心纂要八卷，錄周子、二程子、張子、邵子、朱子、陸九淵、薛瑄、王守仁、羅洪先、顧憲成十一人，以為直接道統之傳。

translations.literal: He also wrote Essentials of the Succession of the Heart in Neo-Confucian Learning in eight juan, recording eleven figures—Zhou Dunyi, the two Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, Shao Yong, Zhu Xi, Lu Jiuyuan, Xue Xuan, Wang Shouren, Luo Hongxian, and Gu Xiancheng—as the direct succession of the transmission of the Way.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote Essentials of the Succession of the Heart in Neo-Confucian Learning in eight juan, recording eleven figures—Zhou Dunyi, the two Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, Shao Yong, Zhu Xi, Lu Jiuyuan, Xue Xuan, Wang Shouren, Luo Hongxian, and Gu Xiancheng—as the direct succession of the transmission of the Way.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，卒，年九十二。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, he died at the age of ninety-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, he died at the age of ninety-two.

sentences.zh: 河南北學者祀之百泉書院。

translations.literal: Scholars north and south of the Yellow River sacrificed to him at Baiquan Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars north and south of the Yellow River sacrificed to him at Baiquan Academy.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，從祀文廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Daoguang, he was enshrined in the Confucian Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Daoguang, he was enshrined in the Confucian Temple.

sentences.zh: 奇逢弟子甚眾，而新安魏一鼇、清苑高鐈、范陽耿極等從遊最早。

translations.literal: Qifeng had very many disciples, but Wei Yiao of Xin’an, Gao Qiao of Qingyuan, Geng Ji of Fanyang, and others were among the earliest to study with him.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng had very many disciples, but Wei Yiao of Xin’an, Gao Qiao of Qingyuan, Geng Ji of Fanyang, and others were among the earliest to study with him.

sentences.zh: 及門問答，一鼇為多。

translations.literal: Among the recorded questions and answers of those who entered his gate, Yiao’s were the most numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Among the recorded questions and answers of those who entered his gate, Yiao’s were the most numerous.

sentences.zh: 睢州湯斌、登封耿介皆仕至監司後往受業，斌自有傳。

translations.literal: Tang Bin of Suizhou and Geng Jie of Dengfeng both went to receive instruction from him after serving as surveillance commissioners; Bin has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Bin of Suizhou and Geng Jie of Dengfeng both went to receive instruction from him after serving as surveillance commissioners; Bin has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 介，字介石，登封人。

translations.literal: Jie, courtesy name Jieshi, was a native of Dengfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Jie, courtesy name Jieshi, was a native of Dengfeng.

sentences.zh: 順治九年進士，翰林院檢討。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi, a jinshi, he was a collating editor in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Shunzhi, a jinshi, he was a collating editor in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 出為福建巡海道，築石城以防盜，

translations.literal: He went out as intendant of the Fujian coastal circuit and built stone walls to guard against pirates.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as intendant of the Fujian coastal circuit and built stone walls to guard against pirates.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，轉江西湖東道，因改官制，除直隸大名道。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, he was transferred to the Jiangxi Hudong circuit; because of changes in the official system, he was appointed intendant of the Zhili Daming circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi, he was transferred to the Jiangxi Hudong circuit; because of changes in the official system, he was appointed intendant of the Zhili Daming circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服除不出。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; when the mourning period ended he did not return to office.
translations.idiomatic: He mourned his mother; when the mourning period ended he did not return to office.

sentences.zh: 篤志躬行，興復嵩陽書院。

translations.literal: With resolute purpose he practiced in person and restored the Songyang Academy.
translations.idiomatic: With resolute purpose he practiced in person and restored the Songyang Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，尚書湯斌疏薦介踐履篤實，冰孽自矢，召為少詹事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Minister Tang Bin memorialized recommending that Jie's conduct was solid and sincere and that he held himself to the severest standards; he was summoned as Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Minister Tang Bin memorialized recommending that Jie's conduct was solid and sincere and that he held himself to the severest standards; he was summoned as Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 會斌被劾，介引疾乞休。

translations.literal: When Bin was impeached, Jie cited illness and requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: When Bin was impeached, Jie cited illness and requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 詹事尹泰等劾介詐疾，並劾斌不當薦介。

translations.literal: Junior Tutor Yin Tai and others impeached Jie for feigning illness and also impeached Bin for improperly recommending Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Tutor Yin Tai and others impeached Jie for feigning illness and also impeached Bin for improperly recommending Jie.

sentences.zh: 尋予假歸，卒。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was granted leave to return home and died.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was granted leave to return home and died.

sentences.zh: 所著有中州道學編、性學要旨、孝經易知、理學正宗，大旨以朱子為宗。

translations.literal: His works include Compendium of the Learning of the Way in the Central Provinces, Essentials of the Study of Human Nature, Easy Understanding of the Classic of Filial Piety, and Orthodox Neo-Confucian Learning; their main purport takes Zhu Xi as authority.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Compendium of the Learning of the Way in the Central Provinces, Essentials of the Study of Human Nature, Easy Understanding of the Classic of Filial Piety, and Orthodox Neo-Confucian Learning; their main purport takes Zhu Xi as authority.

sentences.zh: 中州講學者，有儀封張伯行、柘城竇克勤、上蔡張沐等，皆與斌、介同時。

translations.literal: Among those who lectured in the Central Provinces were Yifeng's Zhang Boxing, Zhecheng's Dou Keqin, Shangcai's Zhang Mu, and others—all contemporaries of Bin and Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Among those who lectured in the Central Provinces were Yifeng's Zhang Boxing, Zhecheng's Dou Keqin, Shangcai's Zhang Mu, and others—all contemporaries of Bin and Jie.

sentences.zh: 伯行自有傳，沐見〈

translations.literal: Boxing has his own biography; Mu is treated in the <
translations.idiomatic: Boxing has his own biography; Mu is treated in the <

sentences.zh: 循吏傳〉，

translations.literal: Diligent Officials biographies>〉,
translations.idiomatic: Biographies of Diligent Officials>〉;

sentences.zh: 克勤附〈

translations.literal: Keqin is appended in the <
translations.idiomatic: Dou Keqin is appended to the <

sentences.zh: 李來章傳〉。

translations.literal: Li Laizhang biography>〉
translations.idiomatic: Biography of Li Laizhang>〉

sentences.zh: 黃宗羲，字太沖，餘姚人，明御史黃尊素長子。

translations.literal: Huang Zongxi, courtesy name Taichong, was from Yuyao and was the eldest son of the Ming censor Huang Zunsu.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zongxi, courtesy name Taichong, was from Yuyao and was the eldest son of the Ming censor Huang Zunsu.

sentences.zh: 尊素為楊、左同志，以劾魏閹死詔獄，事具明史。

translations.literal: Zunsu was a comrade of Yang and Zuo; because he impeached the eunuch Wei, he died in the imperial prison, as is detailed in the History of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Zunsu was a comrade of Yang and Zuo; because he impeached the eunuch Wei, he died in the imperial prison, as is detailed in the History of Ming.

sentences.zh: 思宗即位，宗羲入都訟冤。

translations.literal: When Sizong came to the throne, Zongxi entered the capital to plead the injustice.
translations.idiomatic: When Sizong came to the throne, Zongxi entered the capital to plead the injustice.

sentences.zh: 至則逆閹已磔，即具疏請誅曹欽程、李實。

translations.literal: By the time he arrived, the rebel eunuch had already been torn apart, so he submitted a memorial requesting the execution of Cao Qincheng and Li Shi.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he arrived, the rebel eunuch had already been torn apart, so he submitted a memorial requesting the execution of Cao Qincheng and Li Shi.

sentences.zh: 會廷鞫許顯純、崔應元，宗羲對簿，出所袖錐錐顯純，流血被體；

translations.literal: When Xu Xianchun and Cui Yingyuan were interrogated at court, Zongxi faced them in the proceedings, drew an awl hidden in his sleeve, and stabbed Xianchun until blood covered his body;
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Xianchun and Cui Yingyuan were interrogated at court, Zongxi faced them in the proceedings, drew an awl hidden in his sleeve, and stabbed Xianchun until blood covered his body;

sentences.zh: 又毆應元，拔其鬚歸祭尊素神主前；

translations.literal: he also beat Yingyuan, pulled out his beard, and took it home to offer before Zunsu’s spirit tablet;
translations.idiomatic: he also beat Yingyuan, pulled out his beard, and took it home to offer before Zunsu’s spirit tablet;

sentences.zh: 又追殺牢卒葉咨、顏文仲，蓋尊素絕命於二卒手也。

translations.literal: he further pursued and killed the prison guards Ye Zi and Yan Wenzhong, for Zunsu had died at the hands of those two guards.
translations.idiomatic: he further pursued and killed the prison guards Ye Zi and Yan Wenzhong, for Zunsu had died at the hands of those two guards.

sentences.zh: 時欽程已入逆案，實疏辨原疏非己出，陰致金三千求宗羲弗質，宗羲立奏之，謂：「實今日猶能賄賂公行，其所辨豈足信？」

translations.literal: At the time Qincheng had already been entered in the treason case; Shi submitted a memorial arguing that the original memorial had not come from him and secretly sent three thousand in gold to ask Zongxi not to testify. Zongxi immediately memorialized this, saying: “Shi can still openly practice bribery today; how can what he argues be trusted?”
translations.idiomatic: At the time Qincheng had already been entered in the treason case; Shi submitted a memorial arguing that the original memorial had not come from him and secretly sent three thousand in gold to ask Zongxi not to testify. Zongxi immediately memorialized this, saying: “Shi can still openly practice bribery today; how can what he argues be trusted?”

sentences.zh: 於對簿時復以錐錐之。

translations.literal: During the proceedings he again stabbed him with an awl.
translations.idiomatic: During the proceedings he again stabbed him with an awl.

sentences.zh: 獄竟，偕諸家子弟設祭獄門，哭聲達禁中。

translations.literal: When the case ended, he and the sons and younger brothers of the other families set up sacrifices at the prison gate, and the sound of their weeping reached inside the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the case ended, he and the sons and younger brothers of the other families set up sacrifices at the prison gate, and the sound of their weeping reached inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 思宗聞之，歎曰：「忠臣孤子，甚惻朕懷。」

translations.literal: When Sizong heard of it, he sighed and said: “The orphaned sons of loyal ministers deeply move my heart.”
translations.idiomatic: When Sizong heard of it, he sighed and said: “The orphaned sons of loyal ministers deeply move my heart.”

sentences.zh: 歸，益肆力於學。

translations.literal: After returning home, Zongxi devoted himself still more fully to learning.
translations.idiomatic: After returning home, Zongxi devoted himself still more fully to learning.

sentences.zh: 憤科舉之學錮人，思所以變之。

translations.literal: Angered that examination learning confined people, he thought about how to change it.
translations.idiomatic: Angered that examination learning confined people, he thought about how to change it.

sentences.zh: 既，盡發家藏書讀之，不足，則鈔之同里世學樓鈕氏、澹生堂祁氏，南中則千頃堂黃氏、絳雲樓錢氏，且建續鈔堂於南雷，以承東發之緒。

translations.literal: He then brought out all the books stored in his family and read them; when they were insufficient, he copied books from the Niu family’s Shixue Tower and the Qi family’s Dansheng Hall in his home district, and in the south from the Huang family’s Qianqing Hall and the Qian family’s Jiangyun Tower. He also built the Continued Copying Hall at Nanlei to carry on Dongfa’s tradition.
translations.idiomatic: He then brought out all the books stored in his family and read them; when they were insufficient, he copied books from the Niu family’s Shixue Tower and the Qi family’s Dansheng Hall in his home district, and in the south from the Huang family’s Qianqing Hall and the Qian family’s Jiangyun Tower. He also built the Continued Copying Hall at Nanlei to carry on Dongfa’s tradition.

sentences.zh: 山陰劉宗周倡道蕺山，以忠端遺命從之遊。

translations.literal: Liu Zongzhou of Shanyin promoted the Way at Jishan, and Zongxi studied with him in accordance with Zhongduan’s final charge.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zongzhou of Shanyin promoted the Way at Jishan, and Zongxi studied with him in accordance with Zhongduan’s final charge.

sentences.zh: 而越中承海門周氏之緒，援儒入釋，姚江之緒幾壞。

translations.literal: But in Yue, those who inherited the tradition of the Zhou family of Haimen drew Confucianism into Buddhism, and the Yaojiang tradition was nearly ruined.
translations.idiomatic: But in Yue, those who inherited the tradition of the Zhou family of Haimen drew Confucianism into Buddhism, and the Yaojiang tradition was nearly ruined.

sentences.zh: 宗羲獨約同學六十餘人力排其說。

translations.literal: Zongxi alone gathered more than sixty fellow students and vigorously rejected their doctrines.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi alone gathered more than sixty fellow students and vigorously rejected their doctrines.

sentences.zh: 故蕺山弟子如祁、章諸子皆以名德重，而御侮之功莫如宗羲。

translations.literal: Thus among the Jishan disciples, men such as the Qi and Zhang masters were all honored for reputation and virtue, but none equaled Zongxi in the work of resisting insult.
translations.idiomatic: Thus among the Jishan disciples, men such as the Qi and Zhang masters were all honored for reputation and virtue, but none equaled Zongxi in the work of resisting insult.

sentences.zh: 弟宗炎、宗會，並負異才，自教之，有「東浙三黃」之目。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Zongyan and Zonghui both possessed unusual talent, and he taught them himself; they were known as the “Three Huangs of Eastern Zhejiang.”
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers Zongyan and Zonghui both possessed unusual talent, and he taught them himself; they were known as the “Three Huangs of Eastern Zhejiang.”

sentences.zh: 戊寅，南都作防亂揭攻阮大鋮。

translations.literal: In the wuyin year, the Southern Capital produced an attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the wuyin year, the Southern Capital issued the Anti-Turmoil Manifesto against Ruan Dacheng.

sentences.zh: 東林子弟推無錫顧杲居首，天啟被難諸家推宗羲居首。

translations.literal: The Donglin clique's young members pushed [someone] to the fore; the families that had suffered persecution pushed [someone] to the fore.
translations.idiomatic: The Donglin clique's young members made Gu Gao of Wuxi the lead signatory, while the families persecuted during the Tianqi reign made Zongxi the lead.

sentences.zh: 大鋮恨之刺骨，驟起，遂按揭中一百四十人姓氏，欲盡殺之。

translations.literal: [He] hated them to the bone; rising abruptly, he then copied out the one hundred forty names from the manifesto, intending to kill them all.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Dacheng hated them to the bone; rising abruptly, he copied out the one hundred forty names from the manifesto, intending to kill them all.

sentences.zh: 時宗羲方上書闕下而禍作，遂與杲並逮。

translations.literal: At the time [he] was just submitting a memorial at court when disaster struck, and was arrested together with [Gu Gao].
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi was just submitting a memorial at court when disaster struck, and was arrested together with Gu Gao.

sentences.zh: 母氏姚歎曰：「章妻、滂母乃萃吾一身耶？」

translations.literal: His mother sighed and said: "Must the wife of [Zhang] and the mother of [Peng] be gathered upon my single person?"
translations.idiomatic: His mother, Lady Yao, sighed and said: "Must Zhang's wife and Peng's mother be gathered upon me alone?"

sentences.zh: 駕帖未行，南都已破，宗羲踉蹌歸。

translations.literal: Before the arrest warrant was carried out, the Southern Capital had fallen, and [he] staggered home.
translations.idiomatic: Before the arrest warrant was carried out, the Southern Capital had fallen, and Zongxi staggered home.

sentences.zh: 會孫嘉績、熊汝霖奉魯王監國，畫江而守。

translations.literal: Meeting [Sun Jiaji and Xiong Rulin], they supported the Prince of Lu as regent and guarded south of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiaji and Xiong Rulin supported the Prince of Lu as regent and held the line south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 宗羲糾里中子弟數百人從之，號世忠營。

translations.literal: [He] gathered several hundred local young men to follow him, calling [the unit].
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi gathered several hundred local young men to follow him, naming the unit the Shizhong Battalion.

sentences.zh: 授職方郎，尋改御史，作監國魯元年大統曆頒之浙東。

translations.literal: He was appointed Bureau of Military Appointments director; soon afterward he was changed to censor, and composed [a calendar] and issued it [in Zhedong].
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed director in the Bureau of Military Appointments; soon afterward he was made a censor, composed the Regnal Calendar of the First Year of the Prince of Lu's Regency, and issued it in eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 馬士英奔方國安營，眾言其當誅，熊汝霖恐其挾國安為患也，好言慰之。

translations.literal: [Ma Shiying] fled to [Fang Guo'an's] camp; the crowd said he ought to be executed. [Xiong Rulin] feared he would use [Guo'an] as leverage and spoke soothing words to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shiying fled to Fang Guo'an's camp; the crowd said he ought to be executed. Xiong Rulin feared he would use Guo'an as leverage and spoke soothing words to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 曰：「諸臣力不能殺耳！

translations.literal: [Zongxi] said: "The ministers simply lacked the power to kill him!
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi said: "The ministers simply lacked the power to kill him!

sentences.zh: 春秋之孔子，豈能加於陳恆，但不謂其不當誅也。」

translations.literal: As for [Confucius in the Spring and Autumn Annals], how could he impose [execution] upon [Chen Heng]? Yet that does not mean [Ma Shiying] ought not to have been executed."
translations.idiomatic: Confucius in the Spring and Autumn Annals—how could he have imposed execution on Chen Heng? Yet that does not mean Ma Shiying ought not to have been executed."

sentences.zh: 汝霖謝焉。

translations.literal: [Xiong Rulin] apologized.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Rulin apologized.

sentences.zh: 又遺書王之仁曰：「諸公不沉舟決戰，蓋意在自守也。

translations.literal: He also sent a letter saying: "You gentlemen do not sink your boats and fight to the death; I suppose your intent is merely to hold what you have.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent a letter to Wang Zhiren saying: "You gentlemen do not sink your boats and fight to the death; I suppose your intent is merely to hold what you have.

sentences.zh: 蕞爾三府，以供十萬之眾，必不久支，何守之能為？」

translations.literal: These three tiny prefectures, supplying a host of one hundred thousand, cannot long be sustained—what can holding out accomplish?"
translations.idiomatic: These three tiny prefectures cannot long supply a host of one hundred thousand—what good can mere defense do?"

sentences.zh: 聞者皆韙其言而不能用。

translations.literal: Those who heard it all approved his words, yet they could not act on them.
translations.idiomatic: All who heard him approved his words, yet none could act on them.

sentences.zh: 至是孫嘉績以營卒付宗羲，與王正中合軍得三千人。

translations.literal: At this point [Sun Jiaji] handed over the camp troops to [Zongxi]; together with [Wang Zhengzhong] they combined armies and mustered three thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Sun Jiaji handed over the camp troops to Zongxi; together with Wang Zhengzhong they combined armies and mustered three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 正中者，之仁從子也，以忠義自奮。

translations.literal: [Wang Zhengzhong] was [Wang Zhiren's] nephew and roused himself through loyalty and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhengzhong was Wang Zhiren's nephew and roused himself through loyalty and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 宗羲深結之，使之仁不得撓軍事。

translations.literal: [Zongxi] formed deep ties with him so that [Wang Zhiren] could not interfere with military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi formed deep ties with him so that Wang Zhiren could not interfere with military affairs.

sentences.zh: 遂渡海屯潭山，由海道入太湖，招吳中豪傑，直抵乍浦，約崇德義士孫奭等內應。

translations.literal: He then crossed the sea to garrison [Tanshan], entered [Taihu] by sea route, recruited heroes [in Wu], pressed straight to [Zhapu], and arranged an inner response with righteous men such as [Sun Yi].
translations.idiomatic: He then crossed the sea to garrison at Tanshan, entered Lake Tai by sea route, recruited heroes in Wu, pressed straight to Zhapu, and arranged an inner response with righteous men such as Sun Yi of Chongde.

sentences.zh: 會清師纂嚴不得前，而江上已潰。

translations.literal: The Qing army enforced martial law and could not advance, but the Yangtze line had already collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing army enforced martial law and could not advance, but the Yangtze front had already collapsed.

sentences.zh: 宗羲入四明山結寨自固，餘兵尚五百人，駐兵杖錫寺。

translations.literal: [Zongxi] entered [Siming Mountain] to fortify a camp; the remaining troops still numbered five hundred, stationed at [Zhangxi Temple].
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi entered the Siming Mountains to fortify a camp; the remaining troops still numbered five hundred and were stationed at Zhangxi Temple.

sentences.zh: 微服出訪監國，戒部下善與山民結。

translations.literal: In disguise he went out to visit the regent and admonished his subordinates to treat the mountain people well.
translations.idiomatic: He went in disguise to visit the regent and warned his subordinates to treat the mountain people well.

sentences.zh: 部下不盡遵節制，山民畏禍，潛爇其寨，部將茅翰、汪涵死之。

translations.literal: The subordinates did not fully follow discipline; the mountain people feared disaster and secretly burned the camp; the commanders [Mao Han] and [Wang Han] died.
translations.idiomatic: The subordinates did not fully follow discipline; the mountain people feared disaster and secretly burned the camp; the commanders Mao Han and Wang Han died.

sentences.zh: 宗羲無所歸，捕檄累下，攜子弟入剡中。

translations.literal: [Zongxi] had nowhere to return; arrest warrants were repeatedly issued, and he took his family and entered [Yuezhong].
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi had nowhere to return; arrest warrants were repeatedly issued, and he took his family into the Shan region.

sentences.zh: 聞魯王在海上，仍赴之，授左副都御史。

translations.literal: Hearing that [the Prince of Lu] was at sea, he went to join him again and was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that the Prince of Lu was at sea, he went to join him again and was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 日與吳鍾巒坐舟中，正襟講學，暇則注授時、泰西、回回三曆而已。

translations.literal: Each day he sat in the boat with [Wu Zhongluan], lecturing with formal bearing; in spare time he annotated only the three calendars [Shoushi, Western, and Islamic].
translations.idiomatic: Each day he sat in the boat with Wu Zhongluan, lecturing with formal bearing; in spare time he annotated only the Shoushi, Western, and Islamic calendars.

sentences.zh: 宗羲之從亡也，母氏尚居故里。

translations.literal: When Zongxi followed the fugitive court, his mother still lived in his native village.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongxi followed the fugitive court, his mother still lived in his native village.

sentences.zh: 清廷以勝國遺臣不順命者，錄其家口以聞。

translations.literal: The Qing court recorded the household members of former-dynasty officials who refused to obey its command and reported them to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing court recorded the household members of former-dynasty officials who refused to obey its command and reported them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 宗羲聞之，亟陳情監國，得請，遂變姓名間行歸家。

translations.literal: When Zongxi heard of this, he urgently petitioned the regent; his request was granted, and he changed his name and traveled secretly home.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongxi heard of this, he urgently petitioned the regent; his request was granted, and he changed his name and traveled secretly home.

sentences.zh: 是年監國由健跳至滃洲，復召之，副馮京第乞師日本。

translations.literal: That year the regent moved from Jiantiao to Wengzhou and summoned him again; Zongxi assisted Feng Jingdi in seeking troops from Japan.
translations.idiomatic: That year the regent moved from Jiantiao to Wengzhou and summoned him again; Zongxi assisted Feng Jingdi in seeking troops from Japan.

sentences.zh: 抵長崎，不得請，為賦式微之章以感將士。

translations.literal: They reached Nagasaki but could not obtain what they requested, so he composed a “Shiwei” poem to stir the officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: They reached Nagasaki but could not obtain what they requested, so he composed a “Shiwei” poem to stir the officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 自是東西遷徙無寧居。

translations.literal: From then on he moved east and west and had no settled dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he moved east and west and had no settled dwelling.

sentences.zh: 弟宗炎坐與馮京第交通，刑有日矣，宗羲以計脫之。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zongyan was implicated for communicating with Feng Jingdi, and the day of punishment had been set, but Zongxi saved him by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zongyan was implicated for communicating with Feng Jingdi, and the day of punishment had been set, but Zongxi saved him by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 甲午，張名振間使至，被執，又名捕宗羲。

translations.literal: In the jiawu year, a secret envoy from Zhang Mingzhen arrived and was arrested, and Zongxi was again named for arrest.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiawu year, a secret envoy from Zhang Mingzhen arrived and was arrested, and Zongxi was again named for arrest.

sentences.zh: 丙申，慈水寨主沈爾緒禍作，亦以宗羲為首。

translations.literal: In the bingshen year, when Shen Erxu, master of the Cishui stockade, caused trouble, Zongxi was again treated as the leader.
translations.idiomatic: In the bingshen year, when Shen Erxu, master of the Cishui stockade, caused trouble, Zongxi was again treated as the leader.

sentences.zh: 其得不死，皆有天幸，而宗羲不懾也。

translations.literal: That he escaped death each time was due to heavenly fortune, yet Zongxi was never intimidated.
translations.idiomatic: That he escaped death each time was due to heavenly fortune, yet Zongxi was never intimidated.

sentences.zh: 其后海上傾覆，宗羲無復望，乃奉母返里門，畢力著述，而四方請業之士漸至矣。

translations.literal: Afterward the maritime regime collapsed, and Zongxi had no further hopes; he then brought his mother back to their native home, devoted all his strength to writing, and scholars from every quarter gradually came to study with him.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the maritime regime collapsed, and Zongxi had no further hopes; he then brought his mother back to their native home, devoted all his strength to writing, and scholars from every quarter gradually came to study with him.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔徵博學鴻儒。

translations.literal: In the wuwu year, an edict summoned erudite scholars of broad learning.
translations.idiomatic: In the wuwu year (1679), an edict summoned erudite scholars of broad learning.

sentences.zh: 掌院學士葉方藹寓以詩，敦促就道，再辭以免。

translations.literal: Chancellor Ye Fangai sent him a poem urging him to take the road; he declined twice and was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Ye Fangai sent him a poem urging him to take the road; he declined twice and was exempted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，方藹奉詔同掌院學士徐元文監修明史，將徵之備顧問，督撫以禮來聘，又辭之。

translations.literal: Before long, Fangai received orders together with Chancellor Xu Yuanwen to supervise the compilation of the Ming History; they planned to summon Zongxi as an adviser, and the governor-general and governor came to invite him with courtesy, but he declined again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Fangai received orders together with Chancellor Xu Yuanwen to supervise the compilation of the Ming History; they planned to summon Zongxi as an adviser, and the governor-general and governor came to invite him with courtesy, but he declined again.

sentences.zh: 朝論必不可致，請敕下浙撫鈔其所著書關史事者送入京，其子百家得預參史局事。

translations.literal: Court opinion held that he could by no means be brought; they requested an imperial order for the Zhejiang governor to copy his writings relating to historical matters and send them to the capital, and his son Baijia was allowed to participate in the History Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Court opinion held that he could by no means be brought; they requested an imperial order for the Zhejiang governor to copy his writings relating to historical matters and send them to the capital, and his son Baijia was allowed to participate in the History Bureau.

sentences.zh: 徐乾學侍直，上訪及遺獻，復以宗羲對，且言：「曾經臣弟元文疏薦，惜老不能來。」

translations.literal: Xu Qianxue was attending at court; the emperor inquired about surviving scholars of the former dynasty, and he again answered with Zongxi, saying: "He was once recommended in a memorial by my younger brother Yuanwen; it is a pity he is too old to come."
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qianxue was attending at court; the emperor inquired about surviving scholars of the former dynasty, and he again answered with Zongxi, saying: "He was once recommended in a memorial by my younger brother Yuanwen; it is a pity he is too old to come."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「可召至京，朕不授以事。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "He may be summoned to the capital; I will not assign him duties.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "He may be summoned to the capital; I will not assign him duties.

sentences.zh: 即欲歸，當遣官送之。」

translations.literal: If he wishes to return, officials should be sent to escort him home."
translations.idiomatic: If he wishes to return, officials should be sent to escort him home."

sentences.zh: 乾學對以篤老無來意，上嘆息不置，以為人材之難。

translations.literal: Qianxue replied that Zongxi was deeply aged and had no intention of coming; the emperor sighed repeatedly and lamented how hard it was to obtain men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: Qianxue replied that Zongxi was deeply aged and had no intention of coming; the emperor sighed repeatedly and lamented how hard it was to obtain men of talent.

sentences.zh: 宗羲雖不赴徵車，而史局大議必諮之。

translations.literal: Although Zongxi did not answer the summons cart, major deliberations of the History Bureau always consulted him.
translations.idiomatic: Although Zongxi did not answer the summons cart, major deliberations of the History Bureau always consulted him.

sentences.zh: 曆志出吳任臣之手，總裁千里遺書，乞審正而後定。

translations.literal: The Calendar Treatise came from the hand of Wu Renchen; the chief editor sent a letter a thousand li, begging Zongxi to review and correct it before it was finalized.
translations.idiomatic: The Calendar Treatise came from the hand of Wu Renchen; the chief editor sent a letter a thousand li, begging Zongxi to review and correct it before it was finalized.

sentences.zh: 嘗論宋史別立道學傳，為元儒之陋，明史不當仍其例。

translations.literal: He once argued that separately establishing a Learning of the Way biography in the Song History was a vulgarity of Yuan Confucians and that the Ming History ought not to follow that precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He once argued that separately establishing a Learning of the Way biography in the Song History was a vulgarity of Yuan Confucians and that the Ming History ought not to follow that precedent.

sentences.zh: 朱彝尊適有此議，得宗羲書示眾，遂去之。

translations.literal: Zhu Yizun happened to hold this view; when he received Zongxi's letter and showed it to everyone, the section was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yizun happened to hold this view; when he received Zongxi's letter and showed it to everyone, the section was removed.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十六。

translations.literal: He died at the age of eighty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He died at eighty-six.

sentences.zh: 宗羲之學，出於蕺山，聞誠意慎獨之說，縝密平實。

translations.literal: Zongxi’s learning came from Jishan; hearing the doctrines of sincerity of intention and vigilance in solitude, it was meticulous, plain, and substantial.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxi’s learning came from Jishan; hearing the doctrines of sincerity of intention and vigilance in solitude, it was meticulous, plain, and substantial.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂明人講學，襲語錄之糟粕，不以六經為根柢，束書而從事於遊談。

translations.literal: He once said that Ming lecturers on learning inherited only the dregs of recorded sayings, did not take the Six Classics as their root, put books aside, and busied themselves with idle discussion.
translations.idiomatic: He once said that Ming lecturers on learning inherited only the dregs of recorded sayings, did not take the Six Classics as their root, put books aside, and busied themselves with idle discussion.

sentences.zh: 故問學者必先窮經，經術所以經世。

translations.literal: Therefore, those who inquired into learning had first to exhaust the classics, for classical studies were the means by which to order the world.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, those who inquired into learning had first to exhaust the classics, for classical studies were the means by which to order the world.

sentences.zh: 不為迂儒，必兼讀史。

translations.literal: To avoid becoming pedantic Confucians, they also had to read history.
translations.idiomatic: To avoid becoming pedantic Confucians, they also had to read history.

sentences.zh: 讀史不多，無以證理之變化；多而不求於心，則為俗學。

translations.literal: If one did not read much history, there was no way to verify the transformations of principle; if one read much but did not seek it in the mind, it became vulgar learning.
translations.idiomatic: If one did not read much history, there was no way to verify the transformations of principle; if one read much but did not seek it in the mind, it became vulgar learning.

sentences.zh: 故上下古今，穿穴群言，自天官、地志、九流百家之教，無不精研。

translations.literal: Thus, from high antiquity down to the present, he penetrated the sayings of every school; from celestial offices and geographical records to the teachings of the Nine Currents and Hundred Schools, there was nothing he did not study with precision.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, from high antiquity down to the present, he penetrated the sayings of every school; from celestial offices and geographical records to the teachings of the Nine Currents and Hundred Schools, there was nothing he did not study with precision.

sentences.zh: 所著易學像數論六卷，授書隨筆一卷，律呂新義二卷，孟子師說二卷。

translations.literal: His writings included Treatise on Images and Numbers in Change Learning in six juan, Occasional Notes on Teaching the Documents in one juan, New Meanings of Pitch Pipes in two juan, and Master’s Explanations of Mencius in two juan.
translations.idiomatic: His writings included Treatise on Images and Numbers in Change Learning in six juan, Occasional Notes on Teaching the Documents in one juan, New Meanings of Pitch Pipes in two juan, and Master’s Explanations of Mencius in two juan.

sentences.zh: 文集則有南雷文案、詩案。

translations.literal: His literary collections included Nanlei Prose Drafts and Poetry Drafts.
translations.idiomatic: His literary collections included Nanlei Prose Drafts and Poetry Drafts.

sentences.zh: 今共存南雷文定十一卷，文約四卷。

translations.literal: Now there survive Nanlei Fixed Prose in eleven juan and Condensed Prose in four juan.
translations.idiomatic: Now there survive Nanlei Fixed Prose in eleven juan and Condensed Prose in four juan.

sentences.zh: 又著明儒學案六十二卷，敘述明代講學諸儒流派分合得失頗詳，明文海四百八十二卷，閱明人文集二千餘家，自言與十朝國史相首尾。

translations.literal: He also wrote Cases of Ming Confucian Learning in sixty-two juan, describing in considerable detail the divisions, combinations, successes, and failures of the various Ming Confucian lecture traditions, and Sea of Ming Prose in 482 juan, for which he examined the collected writings of more than two thousand Ming authors, saying himself that it formed a companion from beginning to end with the State History of the Ten Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote Cases of Ming Confucian Learning in sixty-two juan, describing in considerable detail the divisions, combinations, successes, and failures of the various Ming Confucian lecture traditions, and Sea of Ming Prose in 482 juan, for which he examined the collected writings of more than two thousand Ming authors, saying himself that it formed a companion from beginning to end with the State History of the Ten Reigns.

sentences.zh: 又深衣考一卷，今水經一卷，四明山志九卷，歷代甲子考一卷，二程學案二卷，輯明史案二百四十四卷，又明夷待訪錄一卷，皆經世大政。

translations.literal: He also wrote Study of the Deep Robe in one juan, Present Water Classic in one juan, Gazetteer of Siming Mountain in nine juan, Study of Sexagenary Years through the Dynasties in one juan, Cases of the Two Chengs’ Learning in two juan, compiled Cases for the History of Ming in 244 juan, and Waiting for the Dawn in one juan; all concerned the great governance of ordering the world.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote Study of the Deep Robe in one juan, Present Water Classic in one juan, Gazetteer of Siming Mountain in nine juan, Study of Sexagenary Years through the Dynasties in one juan, Cases of the Two Chengs’ Learning in two juan, compiled Cases for the History of Ming in 244 juan, and Waiting for the Dawn in one juan; all concerned the great governance of ordering the world.

sentences.zh: 顧炎武見而歎曰：「三代之治可復也！」

translations.literal: When Gu Yanwu saw it, he sighed and said: “The rule of the Three Dynasties could be restored!”
translations.idiomatic: When Gu Yanwu saw it, he sighed and said: “The rule of the Three Dynasties could be restored!”

sentences.zh: 天文則有大統法辨四卷，時憲書法解新推交食法一卷，圜解一卷，割圜八線解一卷，授時法假如一卷，西洋法假如一卷，回回法假如一卷。

translations.literal: On astronomy, he wrote Discriminations on the Datong Calendar in four juan, Explanation of the Shixian Calendar and the Newly Calculated Method for Eclipses in one juan, Explanation of Circles in one juan, Explanation of the Eight Lines for Cutting the Circle in one juan, Hypothetical Examples of the Shoushi Calendar in one juan, Hypothetical Examples of Western Methods in one juan, and Hypothetical Examples of Islamic Methods in one juan.
translations.idiomatic: On astronomy, he wrote Discriminations on the Datong Calendar in four juan, Explanation of the Shixian Calendar and the Newly Calculated Method for Eclipses in one juan, Explanation of Circles in one juan, Explanation of the Eight Lines for Cutting the Circle in one juan, Hypothetical Examples of the Shoushi Calendar in one juan, Hypothetical Examples of Western Methods in one juan, and Hypothetical Examples of Islamic Methods in one juan.

sentences.zh: 其後梅文鼎本周髀言天文，世驚為不傳之秘，而不知宗羲實開之。

translations.literal: Later, when Mei Wending used the Zhoubi to discuss astronomy, the world was astonished and thought it an untransmitted secret, not knowing that Zongxi had in fact opened the way.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Mei Wending used the Zhoubi to discuss astronomy, the world was astonished and thought it an untransmitted secret, not knowing that Zongxi had in fact opened the way.

sentences.zh: 晚年又輯宋元學案，合之明儒學案，以志七百年儒苑門戶。

translations.literal: In his later years he also compiled Cases of Song and Yuan Learning, joining it to Cases of Ming Confucian Learning to record the lineages of seven hundred years of Confucian scholarship.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he also compiled Cases of Song and Yuan Learning, joining it to Cases of Ming Confucian Learning to record the lineages of seven hundred years of Confucian scholarship.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，從祀文廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, he was enshrined in the Confucian Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong, he was enshrined in the Confucian Temple.

sentences.zh: 宗炎，字晦木。

translations.literal: Zongyan, courtesy name Huimu.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyan, courtesy name Huimu.

sentences.zh: 與兄宗羲、弟宗會俱從宗周遊。

translations.literal: Together with his elder brother Zongxi and younger brother Zonghui, he studied with Zongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Together with his elder brother Zongxi and younger brother Zonghui, he studied with Zongzhou.

sentences.zh: 其學術大略與宗羲等。

translations.literal: His learning was broadly similar to Zongxi’s.
translations.idiomatic: His learning was broadly similar to Zongxi’s.

sentences.zh: 著有周易象辭三十一卷，尋門餘論二卷，圖書辨惑一卷，力闢陳摶之學。

translations.literal: He wrote Images and Phrases of the Zhou Changes in thirty-one juan, Remaining Discussions on Seeking the Gate in two juan, and Discriminating Doubts about Diagrams and Writings in one juan, vigorously refuting Chen Tuan’s learning.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Images and Phrases of the Zhou Changes in thirty-one juan, Remaining Discussions on Seeking the Gate in two juan, and Discriminating Doubts about Diagrams and Writings in one juan, vigorously refuting Chen Tuan’s learning.

sentences.zh: 謂周易未經秦火，不應獨禁其圖，至為道家藏匿二千年始出。

translations.literal: He said that since the Zhou Changes had not passed through the Qin fires, its diagrams alone should not have been suppressed and only emerged after being hidden by Daoists for two thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: He said that since the Zhou Changes had not passed through the Qin fires, its diagrams alone should not have been suppressed and only emerged after being hidden by Daoists for two thousand years.

sentences.zh: 又著六書會通，以正小學。

translations.literal: He also wrote Comprehensive Understanding of the Six Scripts to correct elementary philology.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote Comprehensive Understanding of the Six Scripts to correct elementary philology.

sentences.zh: 謂揚雄但知識奇字，不知識常字，不知常字乃奇字所自出也。

translations.literal: He said Yang Xiong only knew unusual characters and did not know ordinary characters, not realizing that ordinary characters are the source from which unusual characters arise.
translations.idiomatic: He said Yang Xiong only knew unusual characters and did not know ordinary characters, not realizing that ordinary characters are the source from which unusual characters arise.

sentences.zh: 又有二晦、山棲諸集，以故居被火俱亡。

translations.literal: He also had the Erhui and Mountain Dwelling collections, but because his old residence burned, they were all lost.
translations.idiomatic: He also had the Erhui and Mountain Dwelling collections, but because his old residence burned, they were all lost.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十五年，卒，年七十一。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Kangxi, he died at the age of seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Kangxi, he died at the age of seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 宗會，字澤望。

translations.literal: Zonghui, courtesy name Zewang.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghui, courtesy name Zewang.

sentences.zh: 明拔貢生。

translations.literal: He was an outstanding tribute student under the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He was an outstanding tribute student under the Ming.

sentences.zh: 讀書一再過不忘。

translations.literal: When he read a book once or twice, he did not forget it.
translations.idiomatic: When he read a book once or twice, he did not forget it.

sentences.zh: 有縮齋文集十卷。

translations.literal: He had the Suozhai Collected Writings in ten juan.
translations.idiomatic: He had the Suozhai Collected Writings in ten juan.

sentences.zh: 百家，字主一。

translations.literal: Baijia, courtesy name Zhuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Baijia, courtesy name Zhuyi.

sentences.zh: 國子監生。

translations.literal: He was a student of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was a student of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 傳宗羲學，又從梅文鼎問推步法。

translations.literal: He transmitted Zongxi’s learning and also studied calendrical calculation methods with Mei Wending.
translations.idiomatic: He transmitted Zongxi’s learning and also studied calendrical calculation methods with Mei Wending.

sentences.zh: 著句股矩測解原二卷。

translations.literal: He wrote Explanation of the Origins of Right-Triangle and Square Measurement in two juan.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Explanation of the Origins of Right-Triangle and Square Measurement in two juan.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，明史館開，宗羲以老病不能行，徐乾學延百家入史館，成史志數種。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign, when the Ming History Bureau opened, Zongxi was too old and ill to travel, so Xu Qianxue invited Baijia into the History Bureau, where he completed several of the historical treatises.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi reign, when the Ming History Bureau opened, Zongxi was too old and ill to travel, so Xu Qianxue invited Baijia into the History Bureau, where he completed several of the historical treatises.

sentences.zh: 王夫之，字而農，衡陽人。

translations.literal: Wang Fuzhi, courtesy name Ernong, was a native of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fuzhi, styled Ernong, came from Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 與兄介之同舉明崇禎壬午鄉試。

translations.literal: He and his elder brother Jiezhi both passed the provincial examination together in the renshen year of the Chongzhen reign of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He and his elder brother Jiezhi passed the provincial examination together in the renshen year of Ming Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠陷衡州，夫之匿南嶽，賊執其父以為質。

translations.literal: When Zhang Xianzhong captured Hengzhou, Fuzhi hid on Mount Nanyue; the bandits seized his father as a hostage.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Xianzhong took Hengzhou, Fuzhi hid on Mount Nanyue; the rebels seized his father as a hostage.

sentences.zh: 夫之自引刀遍刺肢體，舁往易父。

translations.literal: Fuzhi drew a knife himself and stabbed his limbs all over, then was carried to exchange himself for his father.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhi drew a knife himself and stabbed his limbs all over, then was carried forward to exchange himself for his father.

sentences.zh: 賊見其重創，免之，與父俱歸。

translations.literal: The bandits saw his grave wounds and released him; he and his father both returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing his grave wounds, the rebels released him, and he returned home with his father.

sentences.zh: 明王駐桂林，大學士瞿式耜薦之，授行人。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Ming was stationed at Guilin, Grand Secretary Qu Shisi recommended him, and he was appointed palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming prince was stationed at Guilin, Grand Secretary Qu Shisi recommended him and he was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 時國勢阽危，諸臣仍日相水火。

translations.literal: At the time the national situation was perilously precarious, yet the ministers still daily opposed one another like fire and water.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was on the brink of ruin, yet the ministers still daily fought one another like fire and water.

sentences.zh: 夫之說嚴起恆救金堡等，又三劾王化澄，化澄欲殺之。

translations.literal: Fuzhi urged Yan Qiheng to save Jin Bao and others, and thrice impeached Wang Huacheng; Huacheng wanted to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhi urged Yan Qiheng to save Jin Bao and others, and thrice impeached Wang Huacheng; Huacheng wanted to kill him.

sentences.zh: 聞母病，間道歸。

translations.literal: Hearing that his mother was ill, he returned home by secret route.
