sentences.zh: 程子所謂「一」者事也，所謂「適」者心也。

translations.literal: What Master Cheng called 'one' is affairs; what he called 'deviation' is the heart.
translations.idiomatic: What Master Cheng called 'one' is affairs; what he called 'deviation' is the heart.

sentences.zh: 一其心於所事，而不強事以成心，無適之謂一也。

translations.literal: Unifying the heart in affairs without forcing affairs to complete the heart—this is what 'without deviation' means by 'one.'
translations.idiomatic: Unifying the heart in affairs without forcing affairs to complete the heart—this is what 'without deviation' means by 'one.'

sentences.zh: 當時大興朱筠讀其書，稱其信乎以​​人任己，而頡頑古人。

translations.literal: At the time Zhu Yun of Daxing read his books and praised him as truly trusting people to fulfill himself while stubbornly opposing the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhu Yun of Daxing read his books and praised him as truly trusting people to fulfill himself while stubbornly opposing the ancients.

sentences.zh: 其後善化唐鑑亦稱其功夫體勘精密，由不欺以至誠明。

translations.literal: Later Tang Jian of Shanhua also praised his effort in bodily examination as precise, from not deceiving to utmost sincerity and clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Later Tang Jian of Shanhua also praised his effort in bodily examination as precise, from not deceiving to utmost sincerity and clarity.

sentences.zh: 紱初聘於江，比歸娶，江年二十八矣。

translations.literal: Fu was first betrothed to Jiang; when he returned to marry, Jiang was already twenty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: Fu was first betrothed to Jiang; when he returned to marry, Jiang was already twenty-eight.

sentences.zh: 江嘗語諸弟子曰：「吾歸汝師三十年，未嘗見一怒言、一怒色也。」，

translations.literal: Jiang once told the disciples: "In the thirty years since I joined your master I have never seen one angry word or one angry look.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang once told the disciples: "In the thirty years since I joined your master I have never seen one angry word or one angry look.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年，卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 24, he died, aged sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Qianlong 24 at the age of sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 子思謙，增生，毀卒。

translations.literal: His son Sisqian, an enrolled student, died from grief.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sisqian, an enrolled student, died from grief.

sentences.zh: 同縣余元遴傳其學。

translations.literal: Fellow townsman Yu Yuanlin transmitted his learning.
translations.idiomatic: Fellow townsman Yu Yuanlin transmitted his learning.

sentences.zh: 元遴，字秀書。

translations.literal: Yuanlin, courtesy name Xiushu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanlin, styled Xiushu.

sentences.zh: 諸生。

translations.literal: A licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: A licentiate.

sentences.zh: 著有庸言、詩經蒙說、畫脂集。

translations.literal: He wrote Commonplace Words, Elementary Explanations of the Classic of Poetry, and Collection of Painting Grease.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Commonplace Words, Elementary Explanations of the Classic of Poetry, and Collection of Painting Grease.

sentences.zh: 姚學塽，字晉堂，歸安人。

translations.literal: Yao Xueshuang, courtesy name Jintang, was a native of Gui'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xueshuang, styled Jintang, came from Gui'an.

sentences.zh: 性靜介。

translations.literal: By nature he was quiet and upright.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was quiet and upright.

sentences.zh: 孩稚時，見物不取。

translations.literal: As a child, seeing things he did not take them.
translations.idiomatic: As a child, seeing things he did not take them.

sentences.zh: 父兄坐庭上，久侍立，足不動。

translations.literal: When father and elder brothers sat in the courtyard he stood attending for long periods without moving his feet.
translations.idiomatic: When father and elder brothers sat in the courtyard he stood attending for long periods without moving his feet.

sentences.zh: 既長，讀書，毅然以身學。

translations.literal: Grown, in reading he resolutely took learning as his person.
translations.idiomatic: Grown, in reading he resolutely took learning as his person.

sentences.zh: 父喪骨毀，感動鄉里。

translations.literal: At his father's death his bones wasted with grief, moving the village.
translations.idiomatic: At his father's death his bones wasted with grief, moving the village.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年進士，以中書用。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, a jinshi, appointed a secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing, a jinshi, appointed a secretary.

sentences.zh: 時和珅為大學士，中書於大學士例執弟子禮，學塽恥之，遂歸。

translations.literal: At the time Heshen was grand secretary; secretaries by custom performed disciple rites toward grand secretaries—Xueshuang was shamed and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Heshen was grand secretary; secretaries by custom performed disciple rites toward grand secretaries—Xueshuang was shamed and returned home.

sentences.zh: 後四年和珅伏誅，始入都任職。

translations.literal: Four years later Heshen was executed; only then did he enter the capital and take office.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later Heshen was executed; only then did he enter the capital and take office.

sentences.zh: 十三年，主貴州鄉試。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he served as chief examiner of the Guizhou provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he served as chief examiner of the Guizhou provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 歸途聞母憂，痛父母不得躬侍祿養，遂終身不以妻子自隨。

translations.literal: On the return journey he heard of mourning for his mother; grieving that his parents could not personally receive his salary support, he never thereafter took wife or children with him.
translations.idiomatic: On the return journey he heard of mourning for his mother; grieving that his parents could not personally receive his salary support, he never thereafter took wife or children with him.

sentences.zh: 服闋，至京，轉兵部主事，遷職方司郎中。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he came to the capital, transferred to principal clerk in the Board of War, and was promoted to director in the Bureau of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he came to the capital, transferred to principal clerk in the Board of War, and was promoted to director in the Bureau of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 妻張有婦德，畜一妾請遣侍京寓，不許，乃歸妾父。

translations.literal: His wife Zhang had woman's virtue; she kept a concubine and asked to send her to attend his Beijing residence—he did not permit it, and returned the concubine to her father.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Zhang had woman's virtue; she kept a concubine and asked to send her to attend his Beijing residence—he did not permit it, and returned the concubine to her father.

sentences.zh: 妾方氏，十七，曰：「婦人從一者也，吾事有主矣。」

translations.literal: The concubine Fang, seventeen, said: "A woman follows one; my service already has a master.
translations.idiomatic: The concubine Fang, seventeen, said: "A woman follows one; my service already has a master.

sentences.zh: 竟不嫁。

translations.literal: She never remarried.
translations.idiomatic: She never remarried.

sentences.zh: 學塽居京師四十年，若旅人之阨者，僦僧寺中，霜華盈席，危坐不動。

translations.literal: Xueshuang lived in the capital forty years like a traveler in straits, renting in a monastery; frost covered his mat yet he sat upright without moving.
translations.idiomatic: Xueshuang lived in the capital forty years like a traveler in straits, renting in a monastery; frost covered his mat yet he sat upright without moving.

sentences.zh: 居喪時有氈帽一，布羔裘一，終身服之，藍褸不改，蓋所謂終身之喪者。

translations.literal: During mourning he had one felt cap and one lambskin robe, which he wore all his life without mending the rags—what is called lifelong mourning.
translations.idiomatic: During mourning he had one felt cap and one lambskin robe, which he wore all his life without mending the rags—what is called lifelong mourning.

sentences.zh: 初彭齡掌兵部，請學塽至堂上，躬起肅揖之，學塽亦不往謝。

translations.literal: When Peng Ling first headed the Board of War he invited Xueshuang to the hall and personally rose to bow respectfully; Xueshuang also did not go to thank him.
translations.idiomatic: When Peng Ling first headed the Board of War he invited Xueshuang to the hall and personally rose to bow respectfully; Xueshuang also did not go to thank him.

sentences.zh: 大學士百齡兼管兵部，屢詢司員姚某何在，欲學塽詣其宅一見之，終不往也。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Bai Ling also concurrently headed the Board of War and repeatedly asked where Clerk Yao was, wanting Xueshuang to visit his residence—he never went.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Bai Ling also concurrently headed the Board of War and repeatedly asked where Clerk Yao was, wanting Xueshuang to visit his residence—he never went.

sentences.zh: 學塽六十生辰，同里姚文田貽酒二罌為壽，固辭。

translations.literal: On Xueshuang's sixtieth birthday fellow townsman Yao Wentian sent two jars of wine as congratulations; he firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: On Xueshuang's sixtieth birthday fellow townsman Yao Wentian sent two jars of wine as congratulations; he firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 文田曰：「他日以此相報可乎？」

translations.literal: Wentian said: "May I repay this another day?
translations.idiomatic: Wentian said: "May I repay this another day?

sentences.zh: 乃受之。

translations.literal: Only then did he accept.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did he accept.

sentences.zh: 學塽之學，由狷入中行。

translations.literal: Xueshuang's learning entered the Mean from resoluteness.
translations.idiomatic: Xueshuang's learning entered the Mean from resoluteness.

sentences.zh: 以敬存誠，從嚴毅清苦中發為光風霽月。

translations.literal: With reverence preserving sincerity, from stern hardship and austerity he issued forth as clear breeze after rain.
translations.idiomatic: With reverence preserving sincerity, from stern hardship and austerity he issued forth as clear breeze after rain.

sentences.zh: 闇然不求人知，未嘗向人講學。

translations.literal: Hidden, not seeking others' knowledge, he never lectured to others on learning.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden, not seeking others' knowledge, he never lectured to others on learning.

sentences.zh: 病篤，握其友潘諮手曰：「君勉矣！

translations.literal: As his illness worsened he grasped his friend Pan Zi's hand and said: "Exert yourself, friend!
translations.idiomatic: As his illness worsened he grasped his friend Pan Zi's hand and said: "Exert yourself, friend!

sentences.zh: 人生獨知之地，鮮無愧者。

translations.literal: In life's realm of solitary knowing, few are without shame.
translations.idiomatic: In life's realm of solitary knowing, few are without shame.

sentences.zh: 我生平竭蹶，竟如此止。

translations.literal: All my life I have struggled hard, yet it ends just like this.
translations.idiomatic: All my life I have struggled hard, yet it ends just like this.

sentences.zh: 君亦就衰盡，所得為俟年而已。」

translations.literal: You too are nearing decline; what remains is to await the years.
translations.idiomatic: You too are nearing decline; what remains is to await the years.

sentences.zh: 遂逝，年六十有六。

translations.literal: He then passed away, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He then passed away, aged sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 諮，字少白，會稽人。

translations.literal: Zi, courtesy name Shaobai, was a native of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Zi, styled Shaobai, came from Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 少卓犖，好獨遊天下奇山水，足跡逾數万裡。

translations.literal: In youth he was outstanding; he loved to travel alone through the world's strange mountains and waters; his footsteps exceeded tens of thousands of li.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was outstanding; he loved to travel alone through the world's strange mountains and waters; his footsteps exceeded tens of thousands of li.

sentences.zh: 與學塽友善，日求寡過，以無玷古人。

translations.literal: He was friendly with Xueshuang, daily seeking to reduce faults so as not to stain the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: He was friendly with Xueshuang, daily seeking to reduce faults so as not to stain the ancients.

sentences.zh: 與長民者言，言愛人；

translations.literal: Speaking with those who govern the people, he spoke of loving people;
translations.idiomatic: Speaking with those who govern the people, he spoke of loving people;

sentences.zh: 與里老言，言耕鑿樹畜；

translations.literal: speaking with village elders, he spoke of plowing, digging, planting, and raising livestock;
translations.idiomatic: speaking with village elders, he spoke of plowing, digging, planting, and raising livestock;

sentences.zh: 與士人言，言孝弟忠信。

translations.literal: speaking with scholars, he spoke of filial piety, brotherliness, loyalty, and faith.
translations.idiomatic: speaking with scholars, he spoke of filial piety, brotherliness, loyalty, and faith.

sentences.zh: 遇名下士，則告以實行為首務，尤競競於義利之辨。

translations.literal: Meeting renowned scholars he told them practical conduct was the first task, especially vigilant in distinguishing righteousness from profit.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting renowned scholars he told them practical conduct was the first task, especially vigilant in distinguishing righteousness from profit.

sentences.zh: 居惟一襥被，日兩蔬食。

translations.literal: In dwelling he had only one bundle of bedding; daily two vegetable meals.
translations.idiomatic: In dwelling he had only one bundle of bedding; daily two vegetable meals.

sentences.zh: 食有餘，則以給人之困者。

translations.literal: When food remained he gave it to those in hardship.
translations.idiomatic: When food remained he gave it to those in hardship.

sentences.zh: 有數人賚金為其母壽，不可返，乃各取少許。

translations.literal: Several men brought gold for his mother's birthday; unable to return it, he took a little from each.
translations.idiomatic: Several men brought gold for his mother's birthday; unable to return it, he took a little from each.

sentences.zh: 其母知之，怒曰：「汝見僧以如來像丐巿者乎？

translations.literal: When his mother learned of it she angrily said: "Have you seen monks begging in the market with images of the Tathagata?
translations.idiomatic: When his mother learned of it she angrily said: "Have you seen monks begging in the market with images of the Tathagata?

sentences.zh: 吾其為像也！」

translations.literal: Am I such an image!
translations.idiomatic: Am I such an image!

sentences.zh: 乃謝而盡散之。

translations.literal: He then apologized and distributed it all.
translations.idiomatic: He then apologized and distributed it all.

sentences.zh: 著有古文八卷，詩五卷，常語二卷。

translations.literal: He wrote Ancient Prose in eight juan, Poetry in five juan, and Common Sayings in two juan.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Ancient Prose in eight juan, Poetry in five juan, and Common Sayings in two juan.

sentences.zh: 唐鑑，字鏡海，善化人。

translations.literal: Tang Jian, courtesy name Jinghai, was a native of Shanhua.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Jian, styled Jinghai, came from Shanhua.

sentences.zh: 父仲冕，陝西布政使，自有傳。

translations.literal: His father Zhongmian was governor of Shaanxi and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhongmian was governor of Shaanxi and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 鑑，嘉慶十四年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: Jian became a jinshi in Jiaqing year fourteen and was changed to Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: Jian became a jinshi in Jiaqing year fourteen and was changed to Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授檢討。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授浙江道監察御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed censor of the Zhejiang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was appointed censor of the Zhejiang circuit.

sentences.zh: 坐論淮鹽引地一疏，吏議鐫級，以六部員外郎降補。

translations.literal: For a memorial discussing Huai salt certificate lands he was reduced in rank by official review and demoted to fill a vacancy as vice director in one of the Six Boards.
translations.idiomatic: For a memorial discussing Huai salt certificate lands he was reduced in rank by official review and demoted to fill a vacancy as vice director in one of the Six Boards.

sentences.zh: 會宣宗登極，詔中外大臣各舉所知，諸城劉鐶之薦鑑出知廣西平樂府，擢安徽寧池太廣道。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong ascended the throne an edict ordered inner and outer ministers each to recommend those they knew; Liu Huanzhi of Zhucheng recommended Jian and he was sent out as prefect of Pingle in Guangxi, then promoted to intendant of Ningchi-Taiguang in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong ascended the throne an edict ordered inner and outer ministers each to recommend those they knew; Liu Huanzhi of Zhucheng recommended Jian and he was sent out as prefect of Pingle in Guangxi, then promoted to intendant of Ningchi-Taiguang in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 調江安糧道，擢山西按察使。

translations.literal: Transferred to grain intendant of Jiang'an, promoted to judicial commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to grain intendant of Jiang'an, promoted to judicial commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 遷貴州，擢浙江布政使，調江寧，內召為太常寺卿。

translations.literal: Moved to Guizhou, promoted to financial commissioner of Zhejiang, transferred to Jiangning, and summoned within the capital as chief minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Moved to Guizhou, promoted to financial commissioner of Zhejiang, transferred to Jiangning, and summoned within the capital as chief minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 海疆事起，嚴劾琦善、耆英等，直聲震天下。

translations.literal: When the coastal crisis arose he sternly impeached Qishan, Qiying, and others; his upright reputation shook the empire.
translations.idiomatic: When the coastal crisis arose he sternly impeached Qishan, Qiying, and others; his upright reputation shook the empire.

sentences.zh: 鑑潛研性道，宗尚洛、閩諸賢。

translations.literal: Jian secretly studied human nature and the Way and revered the sages of Luo and Min.
translations.idiomatic: Jian secretly studied human nature and the Way and revered the sages of Luo and Min.

sentences.zh: 著學案小識，推陸隴其為傳道之首，以示宗旨。

translations.literal: He wrote Brief Knowledge of Case Studies, placing Lu Longqi first among those who transmitted the Way, to show his standard.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Brief Knowledge of Case Studies, placing Lu Longqi first among those who transmitted the Way, to show his standard.

sentences.zh: 時蒙古倭仁，湘鄉曾國籓，六安吳廷棟，昆明竇垿、何桂珍皆從鑑考問學業，陋室危坐，精思力踐。

translations.literal: At the time Woren of Mongolia, Zeng Guofan of Xiangxiang, Wu Tingdong of Lu'an, and Dou Kai and He Guizhen of Kunming all studied with Jian, sitting upright in humble rooms, thinking deeply and practicing strenuously.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Woren of Mongolia, Zeng Guofan of Xiangxiang, Wu Tingdong of Lu'an, and Dou Kai and He Guizhen of Kunming all studied with Jian, sitting upright in humble rooms, thinking deeply and practicing strenuously.

sentences.zh: 年七十，斯須必敬。

translations.literal: At seventy, in every moment he was reverent.
translations.idiomatic: At seventy, in every moment he was reverent.

sentences.zh: 致仕南歸，主講金陵書院。

translations.literal: Retiring south, he lectured at the Jinling Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Retiring south, he lectured at the Jinling Academy.

sentences.zh: 文宗踐阼，有詔召鑑赴闕，入對十五次，中外利弊，無所不罄。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong ascended the throne an edict summoned Jian to court; he entered audience fifteen times and fully expounded inner and outer advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong ascended the throne an edict summoned Jian to court; he entered audience fifteen times and fully expounded inner and outer advantages and disadvantages.

sentences.zh: 上以其力陳衰老，不復強之服官，令還江南，矜式多士，

translations.literal: The emperor, because he strongly stated his old age, no longer forced him to serve in office and ordered him back to Jiangnan to be a model for many scholars.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because he strongly stated his old age, no longer forced him to serve in office and ordered him back to Jiangnan to be a model for many scholars.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，還湘，卜居於寧鄉之善嶺山，深衣蔬食，泊然自怡。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, he returned to Hunan and chose to dwell on Shanling Mountain in Ningxiang, wearing deep robes and eating vegetables, content and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng, he returned to Hunan and chose to dwell on Shanling Mountain in Ningxiang, wearing deep robes and eating vegetables, content and at ease.

sentences.zh: 晚歲著讀易小識，編次朱子全集，別為義例，以發紫陽之蘊。

translations.literal: In his later years he wrote Brief Knowledge of Reading the Changes, arranged Zhu Xi's collected works with separate categories of meaning to unfold Ziyang's profundity.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he wrote Brief Knowledge of Reading the Changes, arranged Zhu Xi's collected works with separate categories of meaning to unfold Ziyang's profundity.

sentences.zh: 十一年，卒，年八十有四。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he died, aged eighty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he died, aged eighty-four.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓為上遺疏，賜諡確慎。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan submitted a posthumous memorial for him; he was granted the posthumous title Que Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan submitted a posthumous memorial for him; he was granted the posthumous title Que Shen.

sentences.zh: 著有朱子年譜考異、省身日課、畿輔水利備覽、易反身錄、讀禮小事記等書。

translations.literal: His works include Textual Variants in Zhu Xi's Chronological Biography, Daily Self-Examination Lessons, Comprehensive Guide to Water Conservancy in the Capital Region, Record of Self-Reflection on the Changes, and Notes on Minor Matters in Reading the Rituals.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Textual Variants in Zhu Xi's Chronological Biography, Daily Self-Examination Lessons, Comprehensive Guide to Water Conservancy in the Capital Region, Record of Self-Reflection on the Changes, and Notes on Minor Matters in Reading the Rituals.

sentences.zh: 吳嘉賓，字子序，南豐人。

translations.literal: Wu Jiabin, courtesy name Zixu, was a native of Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jiabin, styled Zixu, came from Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 道光十八年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang, a jinshi, changed to Hanlin bachelor, appointed editor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang, a jinshi, changed to Hanlin bachelor, appointed editor.

sentences.zh: 既通籍，尤究心當世利弊。

translations.literal: Once entered on the registers, he especially devoted himself to contemporary advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: Once entered on the registers, he especially devoted himself to contemporary advantages and disadvantages.

sentences.zh: 嘗條陳海疆事宜，上嘉納焉。

translations.literal: He once submitted detailed proposals on coastal affairs; the emperor commended and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: He once submitted detailed proposals on coastal affairs; the emperor commended and accepted them.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，緣事謫戍軍台，尋釋回。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, on account of an affair he was banished to garrison duty, and soon released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on account of an affair he was banished to garrison duty, and soon released and returned.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，以督團兵援郡城功，賞內閣中書。。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianfeng, for merit in leading militia to relieve the prefectural city, he was rewarded with appointment as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianfeng, for merit in leading militia to relieve the prefectural city, he was rewarded with appointment as a secretary in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 於本邑三都墟口擊賊遇害，奉旨賜卹，並建專祠。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, at Sandu Market Mouth in his home county he struck bandits and was killed; an imperial edict granted posthumous honors and a special shrine was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi, at Sandu Market Mouth in his home county he struck bandits and was killed; an imperial edict granted posthumous honors and a special shrine was built.

sentences.zh: 嘉賓學宗陽明，而治經字疏句釋以求據依，非專言心學者，其要歸在潛心獨悟，力求自得。

translations.literal: Jiabin's learning followed Yangming, yet in treating the classics he sought textual basis in word-by-word explanation; he was not one who spoke only of mind-learning—his essential return lay in quiet reflection and solitary understanding, striving for self-attainment.
translations.idiomatic: Jiabin's learning followed Yangming, yet in treating the classics he sought textual basis in word-by-word explanation; he was not one who spoke only of mind-learning—his essential return lay in quiet reflection and solitary understanding, striving for self-attainment.

sentences.zh: 尤長於禮，成禮說二卷，自序云：「小戴記四十九篇，列於學宮。

translations.literal: He was especially skilled in ritual, completing Discourse on Ritual in two juan; his preface says: "The forty-nine chapters of the Elder Dai Record are listed in the academies.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially skilled in ritual, completing Discourse on Ritual in two juan; his preface says: "The forty-nine chapters of the Elder Dai Record are listed in the academies.

sentences.zh: 其高者蓋七十子之微言，下者乃諸博士所摭拾耳。

translations.literal: The loftier are likely the subtle words of the seventy disciples; the lower are what various erudites gathered.
translations.idiomatic: The loftier are likely the subtle words of the seventy disciples; the lower are what various erudites gathered.

sentences.zh: 宋以來取大學、中庸與論、孟列為四書，世無異議；

translations.literal: Since Song, the Great Learning, Doctrine of the Mean, Analects, and Mencius have been grouped as the Four Books, and the world has no dispute;
translations.idiomatic: Since Song, the Great Learning, Doctrine of the Mean, Analects, and Mencius have been grouped as the Four Books, and the world has no dispute;

sentences.zh: 則多聞擇善，固有不必盡同者。

translations.literal: hearing much and choosing what is good, there are naturally points that need not all agree.
translations.idiomatic: hearing much and choosing what is good, there are naturally points that need not all agree.

sentences.zh: 余獨以禮運、內則、樂記、孔子閒居、表記諸篇，為古之遺言，備錄其文，以資講肄。

translations.literal: I alone take the chapters Evolution of Ritual, Inner Rules, Record of Music, Confucius at Leisure, and Record of Conduct as ancient surviving words and record their text fully for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: I alone take the chapters Evolution of Ritual, Inner Rules, Record of Music, Confucius at Leisure, and Record of Conduct as ancient surviving words and record their text fully for instruction.

sentences.zh: 其餘論說多者亦全錄之，否則著吾說所以與鄭君別者，以備異同焉。

translations.literal: Where other chapters have much discussion I also record them fully; otherwise I set forth where my view differs from Master Zheng to preserve agreement and difference.
translations.idiomatic: Where other chapters have much discussion I also record them fully; otherwise I set forth where my view differs from Master Zheng to preserve agreement and difference.

sentences.zh: 易曰『知崇禮卑』，又曰『謙以制禮』。

translations.literal: The Changes says 'knowing what is lofty and honoring what is lowly,' and also 'using humility to regulate ritual.'
translations.idiomatic: The Changes says 'knowing what is lofty and honoring what is lowly,' and also 'using humility to regulate ritual.'

sentences.zh: 夫禮者，自卑而尊人。

translations.literal: Ritual means humbling oneself and honoring others.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual means humbling oneself and honoring others.

sentences.zh: 古之制禮者上也，上之人能自卑，天下誰敢不為禮者。

translations.literal: Those who made ritual in antiquity stood above; when those above can humble themselves, who under Heaven dares not observe ritual?
translations.idiomatic: Those who made ritual in antiquity stood above; when those above can humble themselves, who under Heaven dares not observe ritual?

sentences.zh: 先王之禮，行於父子兄弟夫婦養生送死之間，而謹於東西出入升降辭讓哭泣辟踴之節，使人明乎吾之喜怒哀樂，莫敢逾夫親疏貴賤長幼男女之分；

translations.literal: The former kings' ritual operated among father and son, brother and brother, husband and wife, in nurturing life and sending off the dead, and was careful in the protocols of east and west, going out and entering, ascending and descending, yielding and declining, weeping, wailing, and leaping—making people understand their joy, anger, sorrow, and delight, and none dare transgress the distinctions of closeness and distance, honor and lowliness, elder and younger, male and female;
translations.idiomatic: The former kings' ritual operated among father and son, brother and brother, husband and wife, in nurturing life and sending off the dead, and was careful in the protocols of east and west, going out and entering, ascending and descending, yielding and declining, weeping, wailing, and leaping—making people understand their joy, anger, sorrow, and delight, and none dare transgress the distinctions of closeness and distance, honor and lowliness, elder and younger, male and female;

sentences.zh: 而其至約者，則在於安定其志氣而已，故曰禮、樂不可斯須去身。

translations.literal: yet its most condensed point lies simply in settling aspiration and qi—therefore it is said ritual and music must not for an instant leave the person.
translations.idiomatic: yet its most condensed point lies simply in settling aspiration and qi—therefore it is said ritual and music must not for an instant leave the person.

sentences.zh: 樂者動於內者也，禮者動於外者也。

translations.literal: Music moves within; ritual moves without.
translations.idiomatic: Music moves within; ritual moves without.

sentences.zh: 夫禮、樂不外乎吾身之自動，而奚以求諸千載而上不可究詰之名物像數也乎？」

translations.literal: Ritual and music are nothing beyond the person's own self-movement—why seek them in names, things, and images from a thousand years ago that cannot be fully investigated?
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music are nothing beyond the person's own self-movement—why seek them in names, things, and images from a thousand years ago that cannot be fully investigated?

sentences.zh: 其大旨蓋如此。

translations.literal: His main intent was roughly thus.
translations.idiomatic: His main intent was roughly thus.

sentences.zh: 他著有喪服會通說四卷，周易說十四卷，書說四卷，詩文集十二卷。

translations.literal: His other works include Comprehensive Discourse on Mourning Garments in four juan, Discourse on the Zhou Changes in fourteen juan, Discourse on the Documents in four juan, and Collected Writings and Poems in twelve juan.
translations.idiomatic: His other works include Comprehensive Discourse on Mourning Garments in four juan, Discourse on the Zhou Changes in fourteen juan, Discourse on the Documents in four juan, and Collected Writings and Poems in twelve juan.

sentences.zh: 與嘉賓同時而專力於學者，有劉傳瑩。

translations.literal: Among those who devoted themselves to learning at the same time as Jiabin was Liu Chuanying.
translations.idiomatic: Among those who devoted themselves to learning at the same time as Jiabin was Liu Chuanying.

sentences.zh: 傳瑩，字椒雲，漢陽人。

translations.literal: Chuanying, courtesy name Jiaoyun, was a native of Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chuanying, styled Jiaoyun, came from Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 道光十九年舉人，官國子監學正。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Daoguang, a provincial graduate, he served as director of studies at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Daoguang, a provincial graduate, he served as director of studies at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 始學考據，雜載於書冊之眉，旁求秘本鉤校，硃墨並下，達旦不休。

translations.literal: At first he studied evidential scholarship, scattering notes in book margins, seeking secret editions for collation, red and black ink together, until dawn without rest.
translations.idiomatic: At first he studied evidential scholarship, scattering notes in book margins, seeking secret editions for collation, red and black ink together, until dawn without rest.

sentences.zh: 其治輿地，以尺紙圖一行省所隸之地，墨圍界畫，僅若牛毛。

translations.literal: In treating geography he used a foot of paper to map one province's subordinate territory, circling boundaries in ink like ox hairs.
translations.idiomatic: In treating geography he used a foot of paper to map one province's subordinate territory, circling boundaries in ink like ox hairs.

sentences.zh: 晨起指誦曰：「此某縣也，於漢為某縣；

translations.literal: Rising in the morning he pointed and recited: "This is such-and-such county—in Han it was such-and-such county;
translations.idiomatic: Rising in the morning he pointed and recited: "This is such-and-such county—in Han it was such-and-such county;

sentences.zh: 此某府某州也，於漢為某郡國。」

translations.literal: this is such-and-such prefecture or department—in Han it was such-and-such commandery or kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: this is such-and-such prefecture or department—in Han it was such-and-such commandery or kingdom.

sentences.zh: 凡三四日而熟一紙，易他行省亦如之。

translations.literal: In three or four days he mastered one sheet; changing to another province he did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In three or four days he mastered one sheet; changing to another province he did likewise.

sentences.zh: 久之疾作，不良食飲。

translations.literal: After long time illness arose and he could not eat or drink well.
translations.idiomatic: After long time illness arose and he could not eat or drink well.

sentences.zh: 自以所業者繁雜無當於心，乃發憤歎曰：「凡吾之所為學者何為也哉！

translations.literal: He felt his pursuits were miscellaneous and irrelevant to the heart, and sighed in indignation: "What am I doing all this learning for!
translations.idiomatic: He felt his pursuits were miscellaneous and irrelevant to the heart, and sighed in indignation: "What am I doing all this learning for!

sentences.zh: 舍孝弟取與之不講，而旁鶩瑣瑣，不亦傎乎！」

translations.literal: Abandoning filial piety, brotherliness, and right taking and giving, yet chasing side matters—how perverse!
translations.idiomatic: Abandoning filial piety, brotherliness, and right taking and giving, yet chasing side matters—how perverse!

sentences.zh: 於是取濂、洛以下切己之說，以意時其離合而反復之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he took self-application teachings from Lian and Luo downward, applying his mind to their agreements and differences and returning to them repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he took self-application teachings from Lian and Luo downward, applying his mind to their agreements and differences and returning to them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 嘗語曾國籓曰：「君子之學務本，專而已。

translations.literal: He once told Zeng Guofan: "The noble person's learning holds to the root—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: He once told Zeng Guofan: "The noble person's learning holds to the root—that is all.

sentences.zh: 吾與子敝精神於讎校，費日力於文辭，僥倖於身後不知誰何者之譽。

translations.literal: You and I exhaust spirit in collation, spend days on literary ornament, and hope for posthumous praise from who knows whom.
translations.idiomatic: You and I exhaust spirit in collation, spend days on literary ornament, and hope for posthumous praise from who knows whom.

sentences.zh: 自今以往，可一切罷棄，各敦內行。

translations.literal: From now on we may abandon all this and each cultivate inner conduct.
translations.idiomatic: From now on we may abandon all this and each cultivate inner conduct.

sentences.zh: 沒齒無聞，誓不復悔。」

translations.literal: Unheard of to the end of life—I swear never to regret again.
translations.idiomatic: Unheard of to the end of life—I swear never to regret again.

sentences.zh: 卒，年三十一。

translations.literal: He died, aged thirty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of thirty-one.

sentences.zh: 病中為日記一編，痛自繩檢，遺令處分無憾。

translations.literal: In illness he kept a diary, strictly examining himself; his final instructions left no regret.
translations.idiomatic: In illness he kept a diary, strictly examining himself; his final instructions left no regret.

sentences.zh: 國籓嘗稱其「湛深而敦厚，非其視不視，非其聽不聽，內志外體一準於法，而所以擴充官骸之用，又將推極知識，博綜百氏，以求竟乎其量」。

translations.literal: Guofan once praised him as "deep and generous—what he did not look at he did not look at, what he did not hear he did not hear; inner intent and outer form alike measured by law; yet to expand the uses of body and limbs he would also push knowledge to the limit and broadly synthesize the hundred schools to fulfill his capacity."
translations.idiomatic: Guofan once praised him as "deep and generous—what he did not look at he did not look at, what he did not hear he did not hear; inner intent and outer form alike measured by law; yet to expand the uses of body and limbs he would also push knowledge to the limit and broadly synthesize the hundred schools to fulfill his capacity."

sentences.zh: 世以為知言。

translations.literal: The world considered this knowing speech.
translations.idiomatic: The world considered this knowing speech.

sentences.zh: 朱子所編孟子要略，自來志藝文者皆不著於錄。

translations.literal: Zhu Xi's compiled Essentials of Mencius has never been listed in bibliographies of arts and letters.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi's compiled Essentials of Mencius has never been listed in bibliographies of arts and letters.

sentences.zh: 傳瑩始於金仁山孟子集注考證內搜出之，復還其舊。

translations.literal: Chuanying first searched it out within Jin Renshan's Textual Verification of the Collected Commentary on Mencius and restored it to its original form.
translations.idiomatic: Chuanying first searched it out within Jin Renshan's Textual Verification of the Collected Commentary on Mencius and restored it to its original form.

sentences.zh: 劉熙載，字融齋，興化人。

translations.literal: Liu Xizai, courtesy name Rongzhai, was a native of Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xizai, styled Rongzhai, came from Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 十歲喪父，哭踴如禮。

translations.literal: At ten he lost his father and wept and stamped according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: At ten he lost his father and wept and stamped according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 道光二十四年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In Daoguang year twenty-four he became a jinshi, was changed to Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed editor.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang year twenty-four he became a jinshi, was changed to Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed editor.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，命直上書房。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng year two, he was ordered to serve directly in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng year two, he was ordered to serve directly in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 與大學士倭仁以操尚相友重，論學則有異同。

translations.literal: With Grand Secretary Woren he befriended and valued each other for integrity; in discussing learning they differed.
translations.idiomatic: With Grand Secretary Woren he befriended and valued each other for integrity; in discussing learning they differed.

sentences.zh: 倭仁宗程、朱，熙載則兼取陸、王，以慎獨主敬為宗，而不喜學蔀通辨以下掊擊已甚之談。

translations.literal: Woren honored Cheng and Zhu; Xizai also took Lu and Wang, making reverent attentiveness and cautious solitude his standard, and disliked attacks like Learning Ramparts and Comprehensive Discrimination that beat down too harshly.
translations.idiomatic: Woren honored Cheng and Zhu; Xizai also took Lu and Wang, making reverent attentiveness and cautious solitude his standard, and disliked attacks like Learning Ramparts and Comprehensive Discrimination that beat down too harshly.

sentences.zh: 文宗嘗問所養，對以閉戶讀書。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong once asked what he cultivated; he answered with shutting his door and reading.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong once asked what he cultivated; he answered with shutting his door and reading.

sentences.zh: 御書「性靜情逸」四大字賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor wrote the four characters "Nature Quiet, Feelings at Ease" and bestowed them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote the four characters "Nature Quiet, Feelings at Ease" and bestowed them.

sentences.zh: 以病乞假，巡撫胡林翼特疏薦，

translations.literal: On plea of illness he begged leave; Governor Hu Linyi specially memorialized recommending him.
translations.idiomatic: On plea of illness he begged leave; Governor Hu Linyi specially memorialized recommending him.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，徵為國子監司業，遷詹事府左春坊左中允。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, he was summoned as vice director of the Imperial Academy and promoted to left assistant in the Eastern Palace of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi, he was summoned as vice director of the Imperial Academy and promoted to left assistant in the Eastern Palace of the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 督學廣東，作懲忿、窒慾、遷善、改過四箴訓士，謂士學聖賢，當先從事於此。

translations.literal: As educational commissioner of Guangdong he wrote four admonitions—restraining anger, checking desire, moving toward good, correcting faults—to instruct scholars, saying that in studying sages and worthies one must first begin here.
translations.idiomatic: As educational commissioner of Guangdong he wrote four admonitions—restraining anger, checking desire, moving toward good, correcting faults—to instruct scholars, saying that in studying sages and worthies one must first begin here.

sentences.zh: 所至蕭然如寒素，未滿任乞歸，襥被篋書而已。

translations.literal: Wherever he went he was spare as a poor scholar; before his term ended he begged to return, taking only bedding and books.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he went he was spare as a poor scholar; before his term ended he begged to return, taking only bedding and books.

sentences.zh: 熙載治經，無漢、宋門戶之見。

translations.literal: In treating the classics Xizai had no Han or Song partisan view.
translations.idiomatic: In treating the classics Xizai had no Han or Song partisan view.

sentences.zh: 其論格物，兼取鄭義。

translations.literal: On ge wu he took both Zheng's meaning.
translations.idiomatic: On ge wu he took both Zheng's meaning.

sentences.zh: 論毛詩古韻，不廢吳棫葉音。

translations.literal: On ancient rhymes in the Mao Odes he did not discard Wu Qi's leaf phonetics.
translations.idiomatic: On ancient rhymes in the Mao Odes he did not discard Wu Qi's leaf phonetics.

sentences.zh: 讀爾雅釋詁至「卬、吾、台、予」，以為四字能攝一切之音。

translations.literal: Reading the Erya's Glosses on Old Words to "ang, wu, tai, yu," he held that these four characters could capture all sounds.
translations.idiomatic: Reading the Erya's Glosses on Old Words to "ang, wu, tai, yu," he held that these four characters could capture all sounds.

sentences.zh: 以推開齊合撮，無不如矢貫的。

translations.literal: Extrapolating open, even, closed, and puckered finals, none failed to hit the mark like an arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Extrapolating open, even, closed, and puckered finals, none failed to hit the mark like an arrow.

sentences.zh: 又論六書中較難知者莫如諧聲，疊韻雙聲，皆諧聲也。

translations.literal: He also argued that among the six scripts the hardest to know is phonetic compound; double rhymes and double initials are all phonetic compounds.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that among the six scripts the hardest to know is phonetic compound; double rhymes and double initials are all phonetic compounds.

sentences.zh: 許叔重時雖未有疊韻雙聲之名，然河、可疊韻也；

translations.literal: In Xu Shuzhong's time though the names double rhyme and double initial did not yet exist, he-ke are double rhyme;
translations.idiomatic: In Xu Shuzhong's time though the names double rhyme and double initial did not yet exist, he-ke are double rhyme;

sentences.zh: 江、工雙聲也。

translations.literal: jiang-gong are double initial.
translations.idiomatic: jiang-gong are double initial.

sentences.zh: 孫炎以下切音，下一字為韻，取疊韻，上一字為母，取雙聲，蓋開自許氏。

translations.literal: From Sun Yan onward in cut rhymes the lower character is rhyme, taking double rhyme; the upper character is initial, taking double initial—this opened from Master Xu.
translations.idiomatic: From Sun Yan onward in cut rhymes the lower character is rhyme, taking double rhyme; the upper character is initial, taking double initial—this opened from Master Xu.

sentences.zh: 又作天元正負歌，以明加減乘除相消開方諸法。

translations.literal: He also composed a Song of Celestial Element Positive and Negative to clarify the methods of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, mutual cancellation, and root extraction.
translations.idiomatic: He also composed a Song of Celestial Element Positive and Negative to clarify the methods of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, mutual cancellation, and root extraction.

sentences.zh: 生平於六經子史及仙釋家言靡不通曉，而一以躬行為重。

translations.literal: All his life in the Six Classics, histories, and Daoist and Buddhist teachings nothing he did not understand, yet he always weighted personal practice.
translations.idiomatic: All his life in the Six Classics, histories, and Daoist and Buddhist teachings nothing he did not understand, yet he always weighted personal practice.

sentences.zh: 嘗戒學者曰：「真博必約，真約必博。」

translations.literal: He once admonished scholars: "True breadth must be concise; true concision must be broad.
translations.idiomatic: He once admonished scholars: "True breadth must be concise; true concision must be broad.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「才出於學，器出於養。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Talent comes from learning; capacity comes from nurture.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Talent comes from learning; capacity comes from nurture.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「學必盡人道而已。

translations.literal: He also said: "Learning must exhaust the human Way—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Learning must exhaust the human Way—that is all.

sentences.zh: 士人所處無論窮達，當以正人心、維世道為己任，不可自待菲薄。」

translations.literal: Whatever a scholar's station, poor or eminent, he should take rectifying people's hearts and sustaining the world's Way as his charge and must not treat himself as worthless.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever a scholar's station, poor or eminent, he should take rectifying people's hearts and sustaining the world's Way as his charge and must not treat himself as worthless.

sentences.zh: 平居嘗以「志士不忘在溝壑」、「遯世不見知而不悔」二語自勵。

translations.literal: In daily life he often took the two sayings "the resolute man does not forget he may die in a ditch" and "the recluse unknown to the world does not regret" as self-encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: In daily life he often took the two sayings "the resolute man does not forget he may die in a ditch" and "the recluse unknown to the world does not regret" as self-encouragement.

sentences.zh: 自少至老，未嘗作一妄語。

translations.literal: From youth to old age he never spoke one false word.
translations.idiomatic: From youth to old age he never spoke one false word.

sentences.zh: 表裡渾然，夷險一節。

translations.literal: Inside and outside were wholly one; in ease and danger one standard.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside were wholly one; in ease and danger one standard.

sentences.zh: 主講上海龍門書院十四年，以正學教弟子，有胡安定風。

translations.literal: He lectured at the Longmen Academy in Shanghai for fourteen years, teaching disciples orthodox learning with the manner of Hu Anding.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured at the Longmen Academy in Shanghai for fourteen years, teaching disciples orthodox learning with the manner of Hu Anding.

sentences.zh: 著持志塾言二卷，篤近切實，足為學者法程。

translations.literal: He wrote Holding to Purpose in the Study in two juan—solid, close, and practical, sufficient as a model for scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Holding to Purpose in the Study in two juan—solid, close, and practical, sufficient as a model for scholars.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，卒，年六十九。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu he died, aged sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu he died, aged sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 又有藝概六卷，四音定切四卷，說文雙聲二卷，說文疊韻二卷，昨非集四卷。

translations.literal: He also had Overview of Arts in six juan, Fixed Cut of the Four Tones in four juan, Double Initials in the Explaining Graphs in two juan, Double Rhymes in the Explaining Graphs in two juan, and Yesterday's Errors Collection in four juan.
translations.idiomatic: He also had Overview of Arts in six juan, Fixed Cut of the Four Tones in four juan, Double Initials in the Explaining Graphs in two juan, Double Rhymes in the Explaining Graphs in two juan, and Yesterday's Errors Collection in four juan.

sentences.zh: 朱次琦，字九江，南海人。

translations.literal: Zhu Ciqi, courtesy name Jiujiang, was a native of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ciqi, styled Jiujiang, came from Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 道光二十七年進士，分發山西，攝襄陵縣事，引疾歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang, a jinshi, assigned to Shanxi, he acted as magistrate of Xiangling County and returned on plea of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang, a jinshi, assigned to Shanxi, he acted as magistrate of Xiangling County and returned on plea of illness.

sentences.zh: 次琦生平論學，平實敦大。

translations.literal: Throughout his life Ciqi's discourse on learning was plain, solid, and generous.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his life Ciqi's discourse on learning was plain, solid, and generous.

sentences.zh: 嘗論：「漢之學，鄭康成集之；

translations.literal: He once argued: "Han learning was gathered by Zheng Kangcheng;
translations.idiomatic: He once argued: "Han learning was gathered by Zheng Kangcheng;

sentences.zh: 宋之學，朱子集之。

translations.literal: Song learning was gathered by Master Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Song learning was gathered by Master Zhu.

sentences.zh: 朱子又即漢學而精之者也。

translations.literal: Master Zhu also refined Han learning.
translations.idiomatic: Master Zhu also refined Han learning.

sentences.zh: 宋末以來，殺身成仁之士，遠軼前古，皆朱子力也。

translations.literal: Since late Song, men who died to achieve humaneness far surpassed antiquity—all through Master Zhu's power.
translations.idiomatic: Since late Song, men who died to achieve humaneness far surpassed antiquity—all through Master Zhu's power.

sentences.zh: 然而攻之者互起，有明姚江之學，以致良知為宗，則攻朱子以格物；

translations.literal: Yet attackers arose in turn; in Ming the Yangjiang school made innate knowledge its standard and attacked Master Zhu on ge wu;
translations.idiomatic: Yet attackers arose in turn; in Ming the Yangjiang school made innate knowledge its standard and attacked Master Zhu on ge wu;

sentences.zh: 乾隆中葉至於今日，天下之學，以考據為宗，則攻朱子以空疏。

translations.literal: from mid-Qianlong to today the empire's learning takes evidential scholarship as its standard and attacks Master Zhu as empty and thin.
translations.idiomatic: from mid-Qianlong to today the empire's learning takes evidential scholarship as its standard and attacks Master Zhu as empty and thin.

sentences.zh: 一朱子也，攻之者又矛盾。

translations.literal: One Master Zhu—yet his attackers contradict each other.
translations.idiomatic: One Master Zhu—yet his attackers contradict each other.

sentences.zh: 烏乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 古之言異學也，畔之於道外，而孔子之道隱；

translations.literal: When antiquity spoke of heterodox learning it placed it outside the Way and Confucius's Way was hidden;
translations.idiomatic: When antiquity spoke of heterodox learning it placed it outside the Way and Confucius's Way was hidden;

sentences.zh: 今之言漢學、宋學者咻之於道中，而孔子之道歧。

translations.literal: now those who speak of Han and Song learning clamor for them within the Way and Confucius's Way is divided.
translations.idiomatic: now those who speak of Han and Song learning clamor for them within the Way and Confucius's Way is divided.

sentences.zh: 果其修行讀書蘄之於古之實學，無漢學，無宋學也。」

translations.literal: If they truly practice and read, seeking ancient real learning, there is neither Han learning nor Song learning."
translations.idiomatic: If they truly practice and read, seeking ancient real learning, there is neither Han learning nor Song learning."

sentences.zh: 凡示生徒修行之實四：曰敦行孝弟，曰崇尚氣節，曰變化氣質，曰檢攝威儀；

translations.literal: In all he showed disciples four realities of practice: honoring filial piety and brotherliness, upholding moral fiber, transforming temperament, and regulating bearing and ritual;
translations.idiomatic: In all he showed disciples four realities of practice: honoring filial piety and brotherliness, upholding moral fiber, transforming temperament, and regulating bearing and ritual;

sentences.zh: 讀書之實五：曰經學，曰史學，曰掌故之學，曰性理之學，曰詞章之學。

translations.literal: five realities of reading: classics, history, institutional learning, Neo-Confucian principle, and belles-lettres.
translations.idiomatic: five realities of reading: classics, history, institutional learning, Neo-Confucian principle, and belles-lettres.

sentences.zh: 一時咸推為人倫師表云。

translations.literal: For a time all praised him as a model of human relations.
translations.idiomatic: For a time all praised him as a model of human relations.

sentences.zh: 官襄陵時，縣有平水，與臨汾縣分溉田畝，居民爭利構獄，數年不決。

translations.literal: When magistrate of Xiangling, the county had the Pingshui River, which with Linfen County divided irrigation of fields; residents fought for profit and brought lawsuits unresolved for years.
translations.idiomatic: When magistrate of Xiangling, the county had the Pingshui River, which with Linfen County divided irrigation of fields; residents fought for profit and brought lawsuits unresolved for years.

sentences.zh: 次琦至，博詢訟端，則豪強壟斷居奇，有有水無地者，有有地無水者。

translations.literal: When Ciqi arrived he broadly inquired into the litigation's origin and found powerful families monopolizing and hoarding: some had water but no land, some had land but no water.
translations.idiomatic: When Ciqi arrived he broadly inquired into the litigation's origin and found powerful families monopolizing and hoarding: some had water but no land, some had land but no water.

sentences.zh: 有地無水者，向無買水券，予之地，弗予之水；

translations.literal: Those with land but no water formerly had no water-purchase certificates—give land but not water;
translations.idiomatic: Those with land but no water formerly had no water-purchase certificates—give land but not water;

sentences.zh: 有水無地者，向有買水券，雖無地得以市利。

translations.literal: those with water but no land formerly had water-purchase certificates and though without land could profit in the market.
translations.idiomatic: those with water but no land formerly had water-purchase certificates and though without land could profit in the market.

sentences.zh: 於是定以地隨糧，以水隨地之制。

translations.literal: Thereupon he fixed the system: land follows grain tax, water follows land.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he fixed the system: land follows grain tax, water follows land.

sentences.zh: 又會臨汾縣知縣躬親履畝，兩邑田相若，稅相直也。

translations.literal: He also met with the Linfen county magistrate to personally survey fields; the two counties' fields were similar and taxes equal.
translations.idiomatic: He also met with the Linfen county magistrate to personally survey fields; the two counties' fields were similar and taxes equal.

sentences.zh: 乃定平水為四十分，縣各取其半。

translations.literal: He then fixed Pingshui into forty shares, each county taking half.
translations.idiomatic: He then fixed Pingshui into forty shares, each county taking half.

sentences.zh: 复於境內設四綱維持之：曰水則，曰用人，曰行水，曰陡門。

translations.literal: Further within the territory he established four controls: water regulations, personnel, water distribution, and sluice gates.
translations.idiomatic: Further within the territory he established four controls: water regulations, personnel, water distribution, and sluice gates.

sentences.zh: 實行水田三萬四百畝有奇，邑人立碑頌之。

translations.literal: In practice irrigated fields exceeded thirty thousand four hundred mu; the county erected a stele in praise.
translations.idiomatic: In practice irrigated fields exceeded thirty thousand four hundred mu; the county erected a stele in praise.

sentences.zh: 繫囚趙三不稜，劇盜也，越獄逃。

translations.literal: The prisoner Zhao Sanbuleng, a notorious bandit, escaped jail.
translations.idiomatic: The prisoner Zhao Sanbuleng, a notorious bandit, escaped jail.

sentences.zh: 次琦未抵任，先出重貲購知其所適。

translations.literal: Before Ciqi reached his post he already offered heavy reward to learn where he had gone.
translations.idiomatic: Before Ciqi reached his post he already offered heavy reward to learn where he had gone.

sentences.zh: 亟假郡捕，前半夕疾馳百二十里，至曲沃郭南以俟。

translations.literal: Urgently borrowing prefectural constables, in the first half of the night he galloped one hundred twenty li to wait south of Quwo city wall.
translations.idiomatic: Urgently borrowing prefectural constables, in the first half of the night he galloped one hundred twenty li to wait south of Quwo city wall.

sentences.zh: 盜眾方飲酒家，役前持之，忽樓上下百炬齊明，則赫然襄陵縣鐙也，乃伏地就縛。

translations.literal: The bandits were drinking in a tavern; runners advanced and seized them; suddenly upstairs and down a hundred torches blazed—it was the Xiangling county lantern; they prostrated themselves and submitted to binding.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were drinking in a tavern; runners advanced and seized them; suddenly upstairs and down a hundred torches blazed—it was the Xiangling county lantern; they prostrated themselves and submitted to binding.

sentences.zh: 比縣人迎新尹，尹已尺組係原賊入矣，遠近以為神。

translations.literal: When the county people welcomed the new magistrate, the magistrate had already bound the original bandit with cord; near and far considered it miraculous.
translations.idiomatic: When the county people welcomed the new magistrate, the magistrate had already bound the original bandit with cord; near and far considered it miraculous.

sentences.zh: 每行縣，所至拊循姁姁，老稚迎笑。

translations.literal: On every tour of the county wherever he went he comforted gently; old and young came smiling to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: On every tour of the county wherever he went he comforted gently; old and young came smiling to meet him.

sentences.zh: 有遮訴者，索木椅在道與決，能引服則已，恆終日不笞一人。

translations.literal: When someone blocked the road to plead he took a wooden chair and decided cases on the spot; if they could be persuaded he stopped—often a whole day without beating one person.
translations.idiomatic: When someone blocked the road to plead he took a wooden chair and decided cases on the spot; if they could be persuaded he stopped—often a whole day without beating one person.

sentences.zh: 其他頒讀書日程，創保甲，追社倉二萬石，禁火葬，罪同姓婚，除狼患，卓卓多異政。

translations.literal: Besides this he issued reading schedules, created baojia, restored granaries to twenty thousand shi, forbade cremation, punished marriage within the same surname, eliminated wolf troubles—many outstanding policies.
translations.idiomatic: Besides this he issued reading schedules, created baojia, restored granaries to twenty thousand shi, forbade cremation, punished marriage within the same surname, eliminated wolf troubles—many outstanding policies.

sentences.zh: 在任百九十日，民俗大化。

translations.literal: In office one hundred ninety days, popular custom was greatly transformed.
translations.idiomatic: In office one hundred ninety days, popular custom was greatly transformed.

sentences.zh: 先是南方盜起，北至揚州。

translations.literal: Earlier bandits rose in the south and reached north to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier bandits rose in the south and reached north to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 次琦猶在襄陵，謂宜綢繆全晉，聯絡關、隴，為三難、五易、十可守、八可征之策，大吏不能用。

translations.literal: Ciqi was still in Xiangling and said Shanxi should be prepared as a whole and linked with Pass and Long—he offered strategies of three difficulties, five eases, ten defensible points, and eight points for campaign; great officials could not use them.
translations.idiomatic: Ciqi was still in Xiangling and said Shanxi should be prepared as a whole and linked with Pass and Long—he offered strategies of three difficulties, five eases, ten defensible points, and eight points for campaign; great officials could not use them.

sentences.zh: 居家時稱說浦江鄭氏、江州陳氏諸義門，及朝廷捐產準旌之例。

translations.literal: At home he often spoke of the righteous clans of the Zheng family of Pujiang and Chen family of Jiangzhou, and the court's precedent of donating property for commendation.
translations.idiomatic: At home he often spoke of the righteous clans of the Zheng family of Pujiang and Chen family of Jiangzhou, and the court's precedent of donating property for commendation.

sentences.zh: 由是宗人捐產贍族，合金數万。

translations.literal: Thereupon clansmen donated property to support the lineage, totaling tens of thousands in gold.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon clansmen donated property to support the lineage, totaling tens of thousands in gold.

sentences.zh: 次琦呈請立案，為變通范氏義莊章程，設完課、祀先、養老、勸學、矜恤孤寡諸條，刊石世守之。

translations.literal: Ciqi petitioned to register the case, adapting the regulations of the Fan clan charity estate, establishing articles for completing taxes, sacrificing to ancestors, supporting the aged, encouraging learning, and relieving orphans and widows, carved in stone to be guarded for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Ciqi petitioned to register the case, adapting the regulations of the Fan clan charity estate, establishing articles for completing taxes, sacrificing to ancestors, supporting the aged, encouraging learning, and relieving orphans and widows, carved in stone to be guarded for generations.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，與同邑徐台英奉旨起用，次琦竟不出。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, he and Xu Taiying of the same district were ordered by imperial command to take office, but Ciqi ultimately did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, he and Xu Taiying of the same district were ordered by imperial command to take office, but Ciqi ultimately did not come out.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，賞五品卿銜，逾數月卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, he was granted the honorary rank of fifth-grade minister; after several months he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu, he was granted the honorary rank of fifth-grade minister; after several months he died.

sentences.zh: 著有國朝名臣言行錄、五史實徵錄、晉乘、國朝逸民傳、性學源流、蒙古聞見等書。

translations.literal: He wrote Record of Words and Deeds of Eminent Ministers of the Present Dynasty, Evidential Record of the Five Histories, Chronicle of Jin, Biographies of Recluses of the Present Dynasty, Sources and Development of Nature Learning, Things Seen and Heard among the Mongols, and other works.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Record of Words and Deeds of Eminent Ministers of the Present Dynasty, Evidential Record of the Five Histories, Chronicle of Jin, Biographies of Recluses of the Present Dynasty, Sources and Development of Nature Learning, Things Seen and Heard among the Mongols, and other works.

sentences.zh: 疾革，盡焚之，僅存手輯朱氏傳芳集五卷，撰定南海九江朱氏家譜十二卷，大雅堂詩集一卷，燔餘集一卷，橐中集一卷。

translations.literal: When he was critically ill, he burned them all; only his hand-compiled Zhu Clan Chuanfang Collection in five juan, the Nanhai Jiujiang Zhu Clan Genealogy that he compiled and fixed in twelve juan, Daya Hall Poetry Collection in one juan, Remnants after Burning in one juan, and Collection from the Satchel in one juan survived.
translations.idiomatic: When he was critically ill, he burned them all; only his hand-compiled Zhu Clan Chuanfang Collection in five juan, the Nanhai Jiujiang Zhu Clan Genealogy that he compiled and fixed in twelve juan, Daya Hall Poetry Collection in one juan, Remnants after Burning in one juan, and Collection from the Satchel in one juan survived.

sentences.zh: 成孺，原名蓉鏡，字芙卿，寶應人。

translations.literal: Cheng Ru, original name Rongjing, courtesy name Fuqing, was a native of Baoying.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Ru, original name Rongjing, styled Fuqing, came from Baoying.

sentences.zh: 附生。

translations.literal: A supplemental student.
translations.idiomatic: A supplemental student.

sentences.zh: 性至孝，父歿，三日哭，氣絕而復屬者再。

translations.literal: By nature he was utmost in filial piety; when his father died, during the three days of weeping his breath stopped and returned twice.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was utmost in filial piety; when his father died, during the three days of weeping his breath stopped and returned twice.

sentences.zh: 授經養母，歲歉，粗糲或弗繼，母所御必精鑿。

translations.literal: He taught the classics to support his mother; in lean years coarse grain sometimes failed, yet what his mother ate was always finely husked.
translations.idiomatic: He taught the classics to support his mother; in lean years coarse grain sometimes failed, yet what his mother ate was always finely husked.

sentences.zh: 事母垂六十年，起居飲食之節，有禮經所未嘗言，而以積誠通之者。

translations.literal: Serving his mother for nearly sixty years, in daily rising, eating, and drinking there were points the Ritual Classics never spoke of yet reached through accumulated sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Serving his mother for nearly sixty years, in daily rising, eating, and drinking there were points the Ritual Classics never spoke of yet reached through accumulated sincerity.

sentences.zh: 早邃經學，旁及象緯、輿地、聲韻、字詁，靡不貫徹。

translations.literal: Early he was deep in classical learning, and also thoroughly mastered astronomy, geography, phonology, and glosses.
translations.idiomatic: Early he was deep in classical learning, and also thoroughly mastered astronomy, geography, phonology, and glosses.

sentences.zh: 於金石審定尤精確。

translations.literal: In appraising bronze and stone he was especially precise.
translations.idiomatic: In appraising bronze and stone he was especially precise.

sentences.zh: 久之，寢饋儒先諸書，益有所得。

translations.literal: After long time he fed on the books of earlier Confucians and gained still more.
translations.idiomatic: After long time he fed on the books of earlier Confucians and gained still more.

sentences.zh: 取紫陽日用自警詩，以「味真腴」顏其居，自號曰心巢。

translations.literal: Taking Ziyang's Daily Self-Admonition Poems, he named his dwelling "Tasting True Richness" and styled himself Heart Nest.
translations.idiomatic: Taking Ziyang's Daily Self-Admonition Poems, he named his dwelling "Tasting True Richness" and styled himself Heart Nest.

sentences.zh: 孺於漢、宋兩家，實事求是，不為門戶之見。

translations.literal: Ru in Han and Song schools sought truth from facts and held no partisan view.
translations.idiomatic: Ru in Han and Song schools sought truth from facts and held no partisan view.

sentences.zh: 嘗曰：「為己，則治宋學真儒也，治漢學亦真儒；

translations.literal: He once said: "For oneself, studying Song learning makes a true Confucian, and studying Han learning also makes a true Confucian;
translations.idiomatic: He once said: "For oneself, studying Song learning makes a true Confucian, and studying Han learning also makes a true Confucian;

sentences.zh: 為人，則治漢學偽儒也，治宋學亦偽儒。」

translations.literal: for others, studying Han learning makes a false Confucian, and studying Song learning also makes a false Confucian.
translations.idiomatic: for others, studying Han learning makes a false Confucian, and studying Song learning also makes a false Confucian.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「義理，論語所謂識大是也：考證，識小是也：莫不有聖人之道焉。

translations.literal: He also said: "Principle is what the Analects calls knowing the great; evidential scholarship is knowing the small—both contain the sage's Way.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Principle is what the Analects calls knowing the great; evidential scholarship is knowing the small—both contain the sage's Way.

sentences.zh: 事父事君，識大也；

translations.literal: Serving father and serving ruler is knowing the great;
translations.idiomatic: Serving father and serving ruler is knowing the great;

sentences.zh: 多識鳥獸草木之名，識小也：皆詩教所不廢，然不可無本末輕重之差。」

translations.literal: knowing many names of birds, beasts, plants, and trees is knowing the small—both are what the Odes teach does not discard, yet one cannot lack distinction of root and branch, heavy and light.
translations.idiomatic: knowing many names of birds, beasts, plants, and trees is knowing the small—both are what the Odes teach does not discard, yet one cannot lack distinction of root and branch, heavy and light.

sentences.zh: 湖南學政朱逌然延主校經堂，孺立學程，設「博文」、「約禮」兩齋，湘中士大夫爭自興於學。

translations.literal: Hunan educational commissioner Zhu Youran invited him to head the Jiaojing Hall; Ru established a curriculum and set up the "Broad Learning" and "Concise Ritual" studios; Hunan gentry and officials competed to rouse themselves in learning.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan educational commissioner Zhu Youran invited him to head the Jiaojing Hall; Ru established a curriculum and set up the "Broad Learning" and "Concise Ritual" studios; Hunan gentry and officials competed to rouse themselves in learning.

sentences.zh: 著有禹貢班義述三卷，據地志解禹貢，於今、古文之同異及鄭注與班偶殊者，一一辨證。

translations.literal: He wrote Exposition of Ban's Meaning of Yu's Tribute in three juan, explaining Yu's Tribute according to geographical gazetteers, verifying one by one modern and ancient differences and where Zheng's commentary and Ban occasionally differ.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Exposition of Ban's Meaning of Yu's Tribute in three juan, explaining Yu's Tribute according to geographical gazetteers, verifying one by one modern and ancient differences and where Zheng's commentary and Ban occasionally differ.

sentences.zh: 即有不合，亦不曲護其非。

translations.literal: Even where they did not agree he did not bend to cover error.
translations.idiomatic: Even where they did not agree he did not bend to cover error.

sentences.zh: 尚書歷譜二卷，以殷歷校殷、周曆校周，從違以經為斷。

translations.literal: Chronological Tables of the Documents in two juan used Yin calendar to verify Yin and Zhou calendar to verify Zhou, following or departing as the classic decided.
translations.idiomatic: Chronological Tables of the Documents in two juan used Yin calendar to verify Yin and Zhou calendar to verify Zhou, following or departing as the classic decided.

sentences.zh: 又考太初歷即三統，為太初歷譜一卷，春秋日南至譜一卷。

translations.literal: He also argued the Taichu calendar is the Three Universes, wrote Chronological Table of the Taichu Calendar in one juan and Chronological Table of the Winter Solstice in the Spring and Autumn Annals in one juan.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued the Taichu calendar is the Three Universes, wrote Chronological Table of the Taichu Calendar in one juan and Chronological Table of the Winter Solstice in the Spring and Autumn Annals in one juan.

sentences.zh: 又有切韻表五卷，二百有六表，分二呼而經以四等，緯以三十六母，審辨音聲，不容出入。

translations.literal: He also had Tables of Cut Rhymes in five juan—206 tables, dividing two calls and threading by four grades, wefting by thirty-six initials, discerning sounds without deviation.
translations.idiomatic: He also had Tables of Cut Rhymes in five juan—206 tables, dividing two calls and threading by four grades, wefting by thirty-six initials, discerning sounds without deviation.

sentences.zh: 晚年著述，一以朱子為宗。

translations.literal: In later years his writings all took Master Zhu as standard.
translations.idiomatic: In later years his writings all took Master Zhu as standard.

sentences.zh: 所編我師錄、困勉記、必自錄、庸德錄、東山政教錄，又有國朝學案備忘錄一卷，國朝師儒論略一卷，經義駢枝四卷，五經算術二卷，步算釋例六卷，文錄九卷。

translations.literal: He compiled Records of My Teachers, Record of Struggling to Learn, Record of Must Begin with Self, Record of Ordinary Virtue, and Record of Government and Teaching at Dongshan; he also had Memorandum of Case Studies of the Present Dynasty in one juan, Outline of Present Dynasty Master-Teachers in one juan, Parallel Branches of Classic Meaning in four juan, Arithmetic of the Five Classics in two juan, Explanatory Examples of Step Calculation in six juan, and Literary Record in nine juan.
translations.idiomatic: He compiled Records of My Teachers, Record of Struggling to Learn, Record of Must Begin with Self, Record of Ordinary Virtue, and Record of Government and Teaching at Dongshan; he also had Memorandum of Case Studies of the Present Dynasty in one juan, Outline of Present Dynasty Master-Teachers in one juan, Parallel Branches of Classic Meaning in four juan, Arithmetic of the Five Classics in two juan, Explanatory Examples of Step Calculation in six juan, and Literary Record in nine juan.

sentences.zh: 邵懿辰，字位西，仁和人。

translations.literal: Shao Yichen, courtesy name Weixi, was a native of Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Yichen, styled Weixi, came from Renhe.

sentences.zh: 性峭直，能文章，以名節自厲。

translations.literal: By nature he was stern and upright, skilled at writing, and strict with himself in reputation and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was stern and upright, skilled at writing, and strict with himself in reputation and integrity.

sentences.zh: 於近儒尤慕方苞、李光地之學。

translations.literal: Among recent Confucians he especially admired the learning of Fang Bao and Li Guangdi.
translations.idiomatic: Among recent Confucians he especially admired the learning of Fang Bao and Li Guangdi.

sentences.zh: 道光十一年舉人，授內閣中書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Daoguang, a provincial graduate, appointed secretary in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Daoguang, a provincial graduate, appointed secretary in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 久官京師，因究悉朝章國故，與曾國籓、梅曾亮、朱次琦數輩游處，文益茂美。

translations.literal: Long in office at the capital he therefore thoroughly knew court regulations and national traditions; with Zeng Guofan, Mei Cengliang, Zhu Ciqi, and several others he associated, and his writing grew richer.
translations.idiomatic: Long in office at the capital he therefore thoroughly knew court regulations and national traditions; with Zeng Guofan, Mei Cengliang, Zhu Ciqi, and several others he associated, and his writing grew richer.

sentences.zh: 折節造請高才秀士，有不可，面折之。

translations.literal: He humbled himself to visit talented scholars; when he disapproved he rebuked them to their face.
translations.idiomatic: He humbled himself to visit talented scholars; when he disapproved he rebuked them to their face.

sentences.zh: 不為朋黨，志量恆在天下。

translations.literal: He did not form factions; his aspiration was always for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: He did not form factions; his aspiration was always for the empire.

sentences.zh: 洊升刑部員外郎，入直軍機處。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to vice director in the Board of Punishments, he entered duty at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly promoted to vice director in the Board of Punishments, he entered duty at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 大學士琦善以妄殺熟番下獄，發十九事難之。

translations.literal: When Grand Secretary Qishan was imprisoned for wantonly killing pacified tribesmen, Yichen raised nineteen points challenging him.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Secretary Qishan was imprisoned for wantonly killing pacified tribesmen, Yichen raised nineteen points challenging him.

sentences.zh: 粵亂作，賽尚阿出視師，复上書次輔祁俊藻，力言不可者七端。

translations.literal: When the Guangdong rebellion arose and Saishang'a went to inspect the army, he again wrote the assistant grand secretary Qi Junzao forcefully stating seven points of what must not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the Guangdong rebellion arose and Saishang'a went to inspect the army, he again wrote the assistant grand secretary Qi Junzao forcefully stating seven points of what must not be done.

sentences.zh: 時承平久，京朝官率雍容養望，懿辰獨無媕阿之習，一切持古義相繩責。

translations.literal: Peace had long prevailed; capital officials generally cultivated reputation at ease—Yichen alone had no fawning habit and held everyone to ancient standards.
translations.idiomatic: Peace had long prevailed; capital officials generally cultivated reputation at ease—Yichen alone had no fawning habit and held everyone to ancient standards.

sentences.zh: 由是諸貴人憚之，思屏於外。

translations.literal: Therefore the great feared him and sought to banish him outward.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the great feared him and sought to banish him outward.

sentences.zh: 會粵賊陷江寧，京師震動，乃命視山東河工，未行，復命偕少詹事王履謙巡防河口，

translations.literal: When Guangdong bandits took Jiangning the capital was shaken; he was ordered to inspect Shandong river works, and before departing again ordered with junior tutor Wang Lvqian to patrol river mouths.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangdong bandits took Jiangning the capital was shaken; he was ordered to inspect Shandong river works, and before departing again ordered with junior tutor Wang Lvqian to patrol river mouths.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，坐無效鐫職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng, for ineffectiveness his rank was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng, for ineffectiveness his rank was reduced.

sentences.zh: 既罷歸，則大覃思經籍，著尚書通義、禮經通論、孝經通論，頗採漢學考據家言，而要以大義為歸。

translations.literal: Dismissed and returned, he then deeply pondered the classics and wrote Comprehensive Meaning of the Documents, Comprehensive Discourse on the Ritual Classic, and Comprehensive Discourse on the Classic of Filial Piety—taking much from Han evidential scholarship yet returning to great principle.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed and returned, he then deeply pondered the classics and wrote Comprehensive Meaning of the Documents, Comprehensive Discourse on the Ritual Classic, and Comprehensive Discourse on the Classic of Filial Piety—taking much from Han evidential scholarship yet returning to great principle.

sentences.zh: 十年，賊陷杭州，以奉母先去獲免。

translations.literal: In the tenth year bandits took Hangzhou; because he had left first to escort his mother he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year bandits took Hangzhou; because he had left first to escort his mother he escaped.

sentences.zh: 母卒，既葬，返杭州。

translations.literal: When his mother died and burial was complete he returned to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died and burial was complete he returned to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊再至，則麾妻子出，獨留與巡撫王有齡登陴固守。

translations.literal: When bandits came again he sent wife and children out and alone remained with Governor Wang Youqin to mount the walls and defend firmly.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits came again he sent wife and children out and alone remained with Governor Wang Youqin to mount the walls and defend firmly.

sentences.zh: 十一年，城陷，死之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the city fell and he died for the cause.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the city fell and he died for the cause.

sentences.zh: 時國籓督師江南，聞而歎曰：「嗟乎！

translations.literal: At the time Guofan was commanding in Jiangnan; hearing this he sighed: "Alas!
translations.idiomatic: At the time Guofan was commanding in Jiangnan; hearing this he sighed: "Alas!

sentences.zh: 賢者之處患難，親在，則出避；

translations.literal: How the worthy meet calamity—while parents live, they withdraw to escape;
translations.idiomatic: How the worthy meet calamity—while parents live, they withdraw to escape;

sentences.zh: 親歿，則死之：義之至衷者也。」

translations.literal: when parents are gone, they die—the utmost of righteousness at its core.
translations.idiomatic: when parents are gone, they die—the utmost of righteousness at its core.

sentences.zh: 乃迎致其妻子安慶。

translations.literal: He then welcomed and brought his wife and children to Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: He then welcomed and brought his wife and children to Anqing.

sentences.zh: 先是懿辰以協防杭州復原官，死事聞，贈道銜，祀本省昭忠祠。

translations.literal: Earlier Yichen had been restored to original rank for assisting in defending Hangzhou; when his death in service was reported he was granted posthumous rank and sacrificed in the provincial Loyalty and Righteousness Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yichen had been restored to original rank for assisting in defending Hangzhou; when his death in service was reported he was granted posthumous rank and sacrificed in the provincial Loyalty and Righteousness Shrine.

sentences.zh: 其所著書，遭亂亡佚，長孫章輯錄之，為半岩廬所著書，共三十餘卷。

translations.literal: His writings were lost in the chaos; his eldest grandson Zhang compiled them as Writings from the Banyan Studio, more than thirty juan in all.
translations.idiomatic: His writings were lost in the chaos; his eldest grandson Zhang compiled them as Writings from the Banyan Studio, more than thirty juan in all.

sentences.zh: 懿辰之友，同里伊樂堯、秀水高均儒，皆知名。

translations.literal: Yichen's friends, fellow townsman Yi Leyao and Gaojun Ru of Xiushui, were all renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Yichen's friends, fellow townsman Yi Leyao and Gaojun Ru of Xiushui, were all renowned.

sentences.zh: 均儒，字伯平。

translations.literal: Junru, courtesy name Boping.
translations.idiomatic: Junru, styled Boping.

sentences.zh: 廩貢生。

translations.literal: A senior licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: A senior licentiate.

sentences.zh: 性狷介，嚴取與之節。

translations.literal: By nature upright and aloof, he was strict in taking and giving.
translations.idiomatic: By nature upright and aloof, he was strict in taking and giving.

sentences.zh: 治三禮主鄭氏。

translations.literal: In the Three Rites he followed the Zheng school.
translations.idiomatic: In the Three Rites he followed the Zheng school.

sentences.zh: 尤服膺宋儒，見文士盪行檢者則絕之如讎，人苦其難近。

translations.literal: He especially embraced Song Confucians; seeing literati of dissolute conduct he cut them off like enemies—people found him hard to approach.
translations.idiomatic: He especially embraced Song Confucians; seeing literati of dissolute conduct he cut them off like enemies—people found him hard to approach.

sentences.zh: 著續東軒集。

translations.literal: He wrote Continuation of the Eastern Studio Collection.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Continuation of the Eastern Studio Collection.

sentences.zh: 樂堯，字遇羹。

translations.literal: Leyao, courtesy name Yugeng.
translations.idiomatic: Leyao, styled Yugeng.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年舉人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, a provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng, a provincial graduate.

sentences.zh: 學術宗尚與懿辰同。

translations.literal: His academic allegiance was the same as Yichen's.
translations.idiomatic: His academic allegiance was the same as Yichen's.

sentences.zh: 值寇亂，猶商證經義危城中。

translations.literal: Amid the rebellion he still discussed and verified classic meaning in the besieged city.
translations.idiomatic: Amid the rebellion he still discussed and verified classic meaning in the besieged city.

sentences.zh: 城破，同殉節死。

translations.literal: When the city fell he died together in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he died together in martyrdom.
